types.name: AccessibleVirtualItem
types.comment:
Accessibility node of one *visible* item (architecture document §37).

A virtualized view has no QWidget per logical row, so a screen reader cannot
walk real child widgets. The bridge therefore exposes virtual nodes on
demand: only the rows of the current viewport window exist as interfaces, and
every node reads its text, state and geometry from the model/view when it is
asked. A million-row model still costs zero nodes.

Mapping (see docs/history/accessibility.md):
- a list item is a ListItem, a table row is a Row, a tree node is a TreeItem
(its children are its *visible* children, its parent is its parent node),
- a table cell is a Cell whose parent is the node of its row.
- a Flow item is a Cell directly under its view, with live display coordinates
and a persistent source identity across reflows.
- a Masonry item is also a Cell directly under its view; its columnIndex()
and rectangle are read from the current shortest-column geometry.

The node owns no copy of the data: text comes from the model roles
(DisplayRole/ToolTipRole/StatusTipRole), the geometry from the view's
committed layout, the state from the item flags, the selection model and the
current index.

entries.comment: Row/item node: \a index is the model index of the row (column 0).

types.name: BranchIndicatorState
types.comment:
One indicator cell of a tree row.

The flags are the QTreeView::branch state vocabulary (has-children,
has-siblings, adjoins-item, open/closed) - no style sheet is parsed, so a
renderer can match the states it cares about and ignore the rest.

A row at depth N owns N + 1 cells: cell 0 is the row's own cell and carries
the expand/collapse indicator (QTreeView::branch:adjoins-item), cell L > 0
belongs to the ancestor at depth L and is where the connector lines of a
"├─" style tree are drawn.

entries.comment: The item of this cell has children (has-children).

The item of this cell has a sibling below it at the same level
(has-siblings).

This cell belongs to the row itself (adjoins-item). Only this cell
carries the expand/collapse indicator; the others are ancestors.
The item of this cell is expanded; only meaningful with children.

Absolute level of this cell: 0 = a top level item, `itemDepth` = the
row's own cell (the one with the expand/collapse indicator).
Depth of the row this cell was painted for (0 = top level item).
QTreeView::branch:open / :closed.

documentation.zh: 判断指定节点或当前 branch 状态是否展开。
documentation.en: Check whether the specified node or current branch state is expanded.

documentation.zh: 判断当前 branch 状态是否收起。
documentation.en: Check whether the current branch state is collapsed.

documentation.zh: 判断当前 branch 是否为无子节点的叶节点。

documentation.en: State of an indentation cell passed to a branch renderer. The node cell carries the expansion indicator; ancestor cells can carry connectors. Booleans default to false and depths to 0.

types.name: BranchIndicatorRenderer
types.comment:
Paints the branch indicators of a VirtualTreeView.

The view offers every cell of every visible row, so a renderer can reproduce
the QTreeView look (connector lines plus an arrow/dot) or draw something
completely different. A cell rect is the full indentation wide slot of its
level, in viewport coordinates.

Override either hook: branchIcon() for the simple "one icon per state" case
(the default paintBranch() centres it in the cell), or paintBranch() when the
decoration is not a plain icon.

\a padding is removed from the cell in logical pixels before alignment;

clamped to the padded area and an empty rect is returned when no room

documentation.zh: HeaderGeometry 提供的列几何快照。逻辑序号标识模型列，视觉序号表示显示顺序；内容坐标和 viewport 坐标不可混用。
documentation.en: Column geometry from HeaderGeometry. Logical indexes identify model columns; visual indexes describe display order. Content and viewport coordinates are distinct.

members.name: logicalIndex
members.zh: 模型逻辑列号，初始 -1 表示无效。
members.en: Model column index; initially -1 (invalid).

members.name: visualIndex
members.zh: 视觉顺序中的列号，初始 -1。
members.en: Position in visual order; initially -1.

members.name: contentX
members.zh: 内容坐标中的左边界，初始 0。
members.en: Left boundary in content coordinates; initially 0.

members.name: viewportX
members.zh: viewport 坐标中的左边界，初始 0，随滚动变化。
members.en: Left boundary in viewport coordinates; initially 0; changes with scrolling.

members.name: width
members.zh: 列宽，初始 0；隐藏列为 0。
members.en: Column width; initially 0, also 0 for hidden columns.

members.name: hidden
members.zh: 是否隐藏，初始 false。
members.en: Whether hidden; initially false.

types.name: HeaderGeometry
types.comment:
Single source of truth for column geometry and column state (§14).

The table body and widget header renderers consume this object; neither keeps
an authoritative width, order or visibility copy of its own (§45.10).

entries.signature:
explicit HeaderGeometry(Qt::Orientation orientation = Qt::Horizontal,
                            QObject *parent = nullptr);

documentation.zh: 构造 HeaderGeometry；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
documentation.en: Construct HeaderGeometry with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

documentation.zh: 销毁 HeaderGeometry 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
documentation.en: Destroy HeaderGeometry and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

documentation.zh: 返回主轴或表头方向。
documentation.en: Return the main-axis or header orientation.

entries.comment:
How many sections the geometry *has*.

This is deliberately independent of how many per-section states are stored: a
geometry with identity order and no hidden sections stays compact. Size changes
are sparse; visibility and visual-order edits materialize per-section state.

documentation.zh: 返回表头 section 数量。
documentation.en: Return the header section count.

entries.comment:
Diagnostics: per-section states actually stored. Compact geometry stores only
exceptional sizes and stretch factors, even at very large section counts.

documentation.zh: 返回显式保存状态的 section 数量。
documentation.en: Return the number of sections with explicitly stored state.

entries.comment:
True while the geometry uses identity visual order and no hidden sections.
Sparse size overrides do not change this compact representation.

documentation.zh: 判断尺寸索引是否全部使用统一尺寸。
documentation.en: Check whether the size index uses one uniform size.

entries.comment:
Grows/shrinks the section set at the end. Model structure changes should
use the logical insert/remove/move calls below instead: they keep the
per-section state (width, visibility, explicit size) with the item it
describes, which appending can never do.

documentation.zh: 设置表头 section 数量。
documentation.en: Set the header section count.

entries.comment:
`columnsInserted(parent, first, last)`: the new sections carry the default
state and take the visual slots of the section that followed them (the one
that used to sit at \a first), like QHeaderView: a header in logical order
stays in logical order, a custom order keeps its shape. Every section after
\a first keeps its own state.

documentation.zh: 在指定位置插入几何/尺寸记录并更新后续索引。
documentation.en: Insert geometry or size records at the specified position and update subsequent indexes.

entries.comment:
`columnsRemoved(parent, first, last)`: the sections of the removed columns
are dropped, the ones after them keep their state and shift down.

documentation.zh: 删除指定范围的几何/尺寸记录并更新后续索引。
documentation.en: Remove a range of geometry or size records and update subsequent indexes.

documentation.zh: 返回可见或隐藏 section 数量。
documentation.en: Return the visible or hidden section count.

documentation.zh: 返回可见或隐藏 section 数量。
documentation.en: Return the visible or hidden section count.

documentation.zh: 判断当前集合、窗格或范围是否为空。
documentation.en: Check whether the collection, pane or range is empty.

entries.comment: Size of a section in content coordinates; 0 when hidden/out of range.

documentation.zh: 返回指定 section 的有效尺寸。
documentation.en: Return the effective size of the specified section.

entries.comment: Size of a section even when it is hidden.

documentation.zh: 返回指定 section 存储的尺寸值。
documentation.en: Return the stored size of the specified section.

entries.comment:
In Independent mode, resizing any section freezes all stretching section widths
and clears every stretch setting, even when the size is unchanged. FitExtent
compensates on the right, or on the left for the last visible section.

documentation.zh: 调整指定 section 尺寸并更新列几何。
documentation.en: Resize a specified section and update its geometry.

entries.comment:
Independent preserves ordinary fixed/stretch sizing. FitExtent keeps all visible
sections and their gaps within stretchExtent(), including after edge resizing.

documentation.zh: 底层 section 尺寸策略。表格业务通常用 setColumnResizeMode()；FitExtent 捕获比例并清除普通拉伸设置。
documentation.en: Low-level section-sizing strategy. Table applications normally use setColumnResizeMode(); FitExtent captures proportions and clears ordinary stretching.

members.name: Independent
members.zh: 独立尺寸及普通拉伸策略，默认模式。
members.en: Independent sizes and ordinary stretching; the default.

members.name: FitExtent
members.zh: 尺寸加间距匹配可用长度，拖动按快照比例分摊；极端长度下放宽限制。
members.en: Fit sizes plus gaps to available extent; distribute drags by snapshot proportions, relaxing limits at extremes.

documentation.zh: 返回section 尺寸调整模式。
documentation.en: Return the section resize mode.

entries.comment:
FitExtent captures current proportions and clears ordinary stretch settings.
The mode is view configuration, independent of saveState()/restoreState().

documentation.zh: 设置section 尺寸调整模式。
documentation.en: Set the section resize mode.

entries.comment:
Immutable press-time widths for renderers implementing proportional edge resizing.
Structural or extent changes invalidate the snapshot. It is not persisted.

documentation.zh: 列边界按下时的尺寸快照，用于 resizeSectionFromEdge()。通过 resizeSnapshot() 获取，不要手工拼装；结构或可用长度变化会使快照失效。
documentation.en: Press-time sizing snapshot for resizeSectionFromEdge(). Obtain it with resizeSnapshot() rather than assembling it manually. Structural or extent changes invalidate it.

members.name: sizes
members.zh: 按下时各逻辑 section 的尺寸，初始为空。
members.en: Press-time sizes by logical section; initially empty.

members.name: orderRevision
members.zh: 结构和顺序版本，用于失效检查，初始 0。
members.en: Structure/order revision for invalidation; initially 0.

members.name: fitRevision
members.zh: 填充布局版本，用于失效检查，初始 0。
members.en: Fit-layout revision for invalidation; initially 0.

members.name: extent
members.zh: 捕获时可用总长度，初始 0。
members.en: Available extent at capture time; initially 0.

members.name: minimum
members.zh: 捕获时最小 section 尺寸，初始 0。
members.en: Minimum section size at capture time; initially 0.

members.name: maximum
members.zh: 捕获时最大 section 尺寸，初始 0。
members.en: Maximum section size at capture time; initially 0.

members.name: spacings
members.zh: 捕获时间距数据，初始为空。
members.en: Spacing data at capture time; initially empty.

documentation.zh: 获取当前 section 宽度快照，作为一次连续拖动的基准。
documentation.en: Capture current section widths as the baseline for a continuous resize drag.

entries.signature:
void resizeSectionFromEdge(int logicalIndex, int size, Qt::Edge edge,
                               const ResizeSnapshot &snapshot);
entries.comment:
In FitExtent, LeftEdge/TopEdge distribute the opposite width change before the
target; RightEdge/BottomEdge distribute it after the target, in visual order.
Uses the snapshot ratios so reversing a drag cannot accumulate rounding errors.

documentation.zh: 从指定边缘调整 section，按当前 resizeMode 分配其它列宽；适用于 FitViewport 联动缩放。
documentation.en: Resize a section from the specified edge, distributing other widths according to resizeMode, including FitViewport coupling.

entries.comment: True when the size was set explicitly (user resize or restoreState).

documentation.zh: 判断行或 section 是否有显式尺寸覆盖；这类覆盖优先于自动测量或默认尺寸。
documentation.en: Check for an explicit row or section size override, which takes precedence over measurement or defaults.

documentation.zh: 清除指定或全部显式 section 尺寸，允许默认尺寸策略重新生效。
documentation.en: Clear one or all explicit section sizes so default sizing policies can apply again.

entries.comment:
Forgets every explicitly set size (the sections go back to the default). Used by a
view that mirrors its own row heights and has to start from a clean slate: with the
sparse representation the overrides that are no longer backed by an explicit height
would otherwise stay behind.

documentation.zh: 清除指定或全部显式 section 尺寸，允许默认尺寸策略重新生效。
documentation.en: Clear one or all explicit section sizes so default sizing policies can apply again.

documentation.zh: 返回未覆盖 section 尺寸时的默认值。
documentation.en: Return the default size for sections without overrides.

documentation.zh: 设置未覆盖 section 尺寸时的默认值。
documentation.en: Set the default size for sections without overrides.

entries.comment: Blank pixels between visible sections; excluded after the last section.

documentation.zh: 返回相邻表头 section 间距。
documentation.en: Return the spacing between adjacent header sections.

documentation.zh: 设置相邻表头 section 间距。
documentation.en: Set the spacing between adjacent header sections.

entries.comment:
Replaces the spacing after each logical section. Empty restores sectionSpacing().
Overrides are a transient layout projection and clear on structure changes.

documentation.zh: 覆盖指定 section 后的间距；稀疏版本适合仅少量 section 需要特殊间距。
documentation.en: Override spacing after sections; the sparse variant suits a small number of exceptional gaps.

defaults.zh: 无单独覆盖；所有间距使用 sectionSpacing()，初始为 0。
defaults.en: No per-section overrides; gaps use sectionSpacing(), initially 0.

entries.comment:
Sorted logical-index/spacing pairs for sparse row gaps. Entries equal to the
default spacing are omitted; structure changes clear this projection too.

documentation.zh: 覆盖指定 section 后的间距；稀疏版本适合仅少量 section 需要特殊间距。
documentation.en: Override spacing after sections; the sparse variant suits a small number of exceptional gaps.

defaults.zh: 无单独覆盖；所有间距使用 sectionSpacing()，初始为 0。
defaults.en: No per-section overrides; gaps use sectionSpacing(), initially 0.

documentation.zh: 返回指定列或 section 后的有效间距。
documentation.en: Return the effective spacing after the specified column or section.

entries.comment:
Transient outer spacing, excluded from saveState(). Empty geometry has no outer spacing.
FitExtent includes these bands in its width budget and compresses them if necessary.

documentation.zh: 设置布局首尾边距，常用于中心分割线模式的半间距。
documentation.en: Set leading and trailing layout spacing, typically half-gaps for centered grid lines.

documentation.zh: 返回布局首端或末端间距。
documentation.en: Return the leading or trailing layout spacing.

documentation.zh: 返回布局首端或末端间距。
documentation.en: Return the leading or trailing layout spacing.

documentation.zh: 返回section 最小尺寸。
documentation.en: Return the minimum section size.

documentation.zh: 设置section 最小尺寸。
documentation.en: Set the minimum section size.

documentation.zh: 返回section 最大尺寸。
documentation.en: Return the maximum section size.

documentation.zh: 设置section 最大尺寸。
documentation.en: Set the maximum section size.

entries.comment: Start of a section in content coordinates (hidden sections are skipped).

documentation.zh: 返回section 在内容坐标中的位置。
documentation.en: Return the section position in content coordinates.

entries.comment: Start of a section in viewport coordinates.

documentation.zh: 返回section 在视口中的位置；视觉查询可包含动画位置。
documentation.en: Return the section viewport position; visual queries may include animation.

entries.comment: Logical section containing \a contentOffset, or -1.

documentation.zh: 按内容偏移查询逻辑或可视 section 索引；注意这两种序号在移动列后可能不同。
documentation.en: Resolve a content offset to a logical or visual section index; these can differ after section moves.

entries.comment: Visual index of the section containing \a contentOffset, or -1.

documentation.zh: 按内容偏移查询逻辑或可视 section 索引；注意这两种序号在移动列后可能不同。
documentation.en: Resolve a content offset to a logical or visual section index; these can differ after section moves.

entries.comment: Visible section extent, including inter-section gaps and outer edge spacing.

documentation.zh: 返回布局或尺寸索引的内容总长度。
documentation.en: Return the total content extent of the layout or size index.

documentation.zh: 将可视顺序中的 section 位置转换为逻辑 section 索引。
documentation.en: Map a section position in visual order to its logical section index.

documentation.zh: 将逻辑 section 索引转换成可视顺序中的位置。
documentation.en: Map a logical section index to its position in visual order.

documentation.zh: 移动列或 section 的可视位置；逻辑索引与可视索引不是同一个概念。
documentation.en: Move a column or section visually. Logical and visual indexes are distinct.

entries.signature: void moveLogicalSections(int start, int count, int destination);
entries.comment:
Follows a QAbstractItemModel column move: section state (size,
visibility) shifts with the columns and the visual order is remapped.

documentation.zh: 响应模型逻辑位置移动并同步对应几何或尺寸记录。
documentation.en: Synchronize geometry or size records after a model logical-position move.

entries.signature: void moveLogicalSectionSizes(int start, int count, int destination);
entries.comment:
Remaps sizes after a model row move while keeping identity visual order.
Compact row geometry stays sparse; indexed geometry uses moveLogicalSections().

documentation.zh: 响应模型逻辑位置移动并同步对应几何或尺寸记录。
documentation.en: Synchronize geometry or size records after a model logical-position move.

documentation.zh: 返回指定 section 隐藏状态。
documentation.en: Return the hidden state of the specified section.

documentation.zh: 隐藏或显示指定逻辑 section/列，保持模型数据不变。
documentation.en: Hide or show a logical section/column without changing model data.

documentation.zh: 统一隐藏或显示所有 section。
documentation.en: Hide or show all sections together.

documentation.zh: 返回表头视口滚动偏移量。
documentation.en: Return the header viewport scroll offset.

documentation.zh: 设置表头视口滚动偏移量。
documentation.en: Set the header viewport scroll offset.

documentation.zh: 返回有效滚动偏移上限。
documentation.en: Return the maximum valid scroll offset.

entries.comment: Committed geometry of one section for the current viewport offset.

documentation.zh: 返回指定逻辑列的尺寸、位置和可见性信息。
documentation.en: Return the size, position and visibility of the specified logical column.

entries.comment:
Visible sections for a viewport extent, as *visual* indices: the range
may contain hidden sections, which callers skip.

documentation.zh: 计算当前或指定偏移/长度对应的可见 section 可视索引区间。
documentation.en: Compute the visible section visual-index range for the current or supplied offset and extent.

entries.signature: VisibleRange visibleVisualRangeFor(qint64 windowStart, int viewportExtent) const;
entries.comment:
Visible visual range of an arbitrary window: content x \a windowStart, extent
\a viewportExtent (both in viewport coordinates, i.e. content minus the offset).
A pane header uses it with its own rect, since a pane that follows the committed
geometry starts at its own x inside the viewport (the table's scrolling pane begins
right of the frozen columns).

documentation.zh: 计算当前或指定偏移/长度对应的可见 section 可视索引区间。
documentation.en: Compute the visible section visual-index range for the current or supplied offset and extent.

entries.comment: Logical indices of the visible sections, in visual order.

documentation.zh: 返回按可视顺序排列的可见逻辑列或 section。
documentation.en: Return the visible logical columns or sections in visual order.

entries.comment:
Bumped whenever the visual order of the visible sections may have changed
(move, insert, remove, hide/unhide). A renderer can cache derived state -
e.g. the order it last laid out - and only rebuild it when this number
moved, instead of re-deriving the whole order on every relayout.

documentation.zh: 返回section 顺序修订号，供缓存失效判断。
documentation.en: Return the section order revision used for cache invalidation.

documentation.zh: 返回显示排序指示器的逻辑 section。
documentation.en: Return the logical section showing the sort indicator.

documentation.zh: 返回排序指示器方向。
documentation.en: Return the sort indicator order.

documentation.zh: 设置排序标记对应列和方向；标记本身不等于模型已完成排序。
documentation.en: Set the sort indicator section and order; the indicator alone does not imply the model has been sorted.

entries.comment: Whether the last visible section absorbs what the other sections leave.

documentation.zh: 返回末 section 填充剩余长度开关。
documentation.en: Return the whether the last section fills remaining extent.

documentation.zh: 设置末 section 填充剩余长度开关。
documentation.en: Set the whether the last section fills remaining extent.

entries.comment:
Extent the visible sections should fill, in content coordinates: a table hands in
the width its columns have to cover (the viewport, frozen columns included), a
standalone renderer its own axis extent. In Independent mode, 0 (the default)
means "no target": every section keeps its own size. FitExtent treats 0 as an
empty viewport and temporarily collapses visible sections and their gaps.

Deliberately *not* part of saveState(): the extent belongs to the view showing the
sections, not to the column state an application saved, so a restored state is
measured against the view that restores it.

documentation.zh: 返回比例计算可用长度。
documentation.en: Return the available stretch extent.

documentation.zh: 设置比例计算可用长度。
documentation.en: Set the available stretch extent.

entries.comment:
Share of the leftover extent: the visible sections with a factor > 0 split
`stretchExtent() - <the sizes the other visible sections keep>` in proportion to
their factors, so 1 : 2 : 1 gives the third section twice the width of the first.
0 (the default) is a section that keeps its own size.

The size of a stretching section is *derived*: isSectionSizeExplicit() stays false
for it. Calling resizeSection(), including a header edge drag, on any section
clears all factors and disables stretchLastSection(). Other sections keep their
current sizes; the resized section takes the requested width. Setting a positive
factor explicitly enables proportional sizing again.

documentation.zh: 返回指定 section 比例权重。
documentation.en: Return the stretch weight of the specified section.

documentation.zh: 设置指定 section 比例权重。
documentation.en: Set the stretch weight of the specified section.

defaults.en: 0 for every section; no proportional stretching.

entries.comment:
True while at least one section stretches, i.e. while a stretch pass can change
anything (stretchLastSection() counts as one participant).

documentation.zh: 判断是否存在比例拉伸 section。
documentation.en: Check whether proportional stretch sections exist.

entries.comment: Version 3 stores compact geometry without expanding every section.

documentation.zh: 序列化当前表头布局状态用于持久化；恢复时使用配套 restore 接口。
documentation.en: Serialize current header layout state for persistence; restore it with the matching restore method.

entries.comment:
Restores sizes, order, visibility, sort state and offset. Returns false
(and changes nothing) when the state is invalid or belongs to a different
section count.

documentation.zh: 恢复序列化表头布局；返回值表明数据是否被接受，调用方应处理不兼容或损坏状态。
documentation.en: Restore serialized header layout; the return value indicates acceptance. Handle incompatible or damaged state in the caller.

entries.signature: void sectionResized(int logicalIndex, int oldSize, int newSize);

documentation.zh: section 尺寸改变时发出，参数描述对应索引及尺寸变化。
documentation.en: Emitted when a section is resized, with its index and size-change arguments.

entries.signature: void sectionMoved(int logicalIndex, int oldVisualIndex, int newVisualIndex);

documentation.zh: section 可视位置改变时发出。
documentation.en: Emitted when a section changes visual position.

documentation.zh: section 隐藏或显示状态改变时发出。
documentation.en: Emitted when section visibility changes.

documentation.zh: section 总数改变时发出。
documentation.en: Emitted when the section count changes.

documentation.zh: 排序标记列或方向改变时发出。
documentation.en: Emitted when the sort indicator section or order changes.

documentation.zh: 末 section 拉伸配置改变时发出。
documentation.en: Emitted when last-section stretching changes.

documentation.zh: 尺寸调整模式改变时发出。
documentation.en: Emitted when the resize mode changes.

entries.comment:
The stretch factor of \a logicalIndex changed (a resize that clears factors is
reported through the size signals instead, not as a factor change).

documentation.zh: section 比例权重改变时发出。
documentation.en: Emitted when a section stretch factor changes.

entries.comment:
The viewport offset changed; headers only have to shift, no per-section
work is required (keeps scrolling O(1) instead of O(sections)).

documentation.zh: 水平或表头滚动偏移变化时发出。
documentation.en: Emitted when the horizontal or header scroll offset changes.

entries.comment: Emitted once per change, after the granular signals.

documentation.zh: 几何变化通知；批量信号用于一次处理多项变化，避免逐项重复布局。
documentation.en: Geometry change notification; bulk signals allow handling multiple changes without repeated per-item relayout.

entries.comment:
Emitted when the change is *not* described by a granular signal: the size range, the
default size, the stretch flag, a restored state, or a remap that renames many
sections at once (a model-side move). A renderer that applies sectionResized /
sectionVisibilityChanged / offsetChanged / sortIndicatorChanged itself only has to
re-read the whole geometry on this signal - and thus does not pay an O(sections) pass
for a single column resize (P1-10 of the second review).

documentation.zh: 几何变化通知；批量信号用于一次处理多项变化，避免逐项重复布局。
documentation.en: Geometry change notification; bulk signals allow handling multiple changes without repeated per-item relayout.

types.name: HeaderSection
types.comment:
Passive, reusable header section with binding identity and a layered paint lifecycle.
No panel, state background, separators or text are drawn by this base class.
VirtualHeaderView owns pointer gestures; the adapter updates the logical index on bind.

entries.comment:
Creates a section without taking focus from the owning header's gestures.
Defaults to objectName vivHeaderSection; reused sections keep their name.

documentation.zh: 构造 HeaderSection；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
documentation.en: Construct HeaderSection with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

entries.comment: Current logical section, or -1 while unbound. Read it when handling an event.

documentation.zh: 返回section 逻辑索引。
documentation.en: Return the logical section index.

entries.comment: Replaces binding identity; adapters must clear it when recycling the widget.

documentation.zh: 设置section 逻辑索引。
documentation.en: Set the logical section index.

entries.comment: Immediate header owner, or nullptr for a standalone section or corner widget.

documentation.zh: 返回关联的视图、表格或表头对象。
documentation.en: Return the associated view, table or header object.

entries.comment: Owning table, or nullptr for a header used outside a table.

documentation.zh: 返回关联的视图、表格或表头对象。
documentation.en: Return the associated view, table or header object.

entries.comment: Header axis; standalone sections and corner widgets use Qt::Horizontal.

documentation.zh: 返回主轴或表头方向。
documentation.en: Return the main-axis or header orientation.

entries.comment:
Current header state and shared animation progress, independent of background visibility.
Standalone and unbound sections return an empty state.

documentation.zh: 返回指定项目或 section 的当前视觉状态与动画进度。adapter 与背景绘制应使用同一份状态。
documentation.en: Return the current visual state and animation progress for an item or section. Adapters and background painting should use consistent state.

types.name: HeaderSectionAdapter
types.comment:
Adapter for HeaderSection and its subclasses; binds identity without providing labels.
Override createSection() for styled or custom content while retaining bind/unbind.

entries.comment: Creates an unstyled HeaderSection by default.

documentation.zh: 在 parent 下创建表头 section 控件，数据由 bindSection 填充。
documentation.en: Create a header section widget under parent; bindSection supplies its data.

entries.comment: Supplies the current logical identity on every bind, including reuse.

types.name: HeaderViewInterface
types.comment:
Renderer abstraction of a table header (architecture document §15/§16/§17).

The default implementation is VirtualHeaderView with its built-in LabelHeaderAdapter.
Applications can replace its adapter or install a custom renderer implementing this
interface.

Every renderer consumes the same HeaderGeometry, so the table body never depends on how
the header is rendered. The interface is intentionally not a QWidget: an implementation
may be one (VirtualHeaderView is), but the table only talks to this contract.

Enables sort interaction; the header reports clicks by writing the sort
indicator into HeaderGeometry, and the table reacts to that change.

entries.comment:
Tells the renderer where the viewport starts inside the view, so a widget
based header can derive its own coordinates from HeaderGeometry (which is
expressed in viewport coordinates). The native adapter does not need it.

documentation.zh: 设置表头对齐到内容视口的起点。
documentation.en: Set the origin aligning the header with the content viewport.

defaults.zh: 接口本身不保存统一配置；内置 VirtualHeaderView：未显式设置，按所属视图/父控件计算；表格布局时设置原点。
defaults.en: The interface stores no shared configuration; built-in VirtualHeaderView: No explicit origin; derived from the owning view/parent, then supplied by table layout.

entries.signature: virtual void setPaneFilter(const QVector<int> &logicalColumns, bool frozen);
entries.comment:
Restricts the header to one pane (§31): only \a logicalColumns are shown,
read from the same geometry (a pane is never a width copy). When
\a frozen the header ignores the horizontal offset. Renderers that cannot
split sections may ignore this and keep showing every section.

documentation.zh: 只让表头显示指定窗格内的 section。
documentation.en: Restrict the header to sections belonging to a specified pane.

defaults.zh: 接口本身不保存统一配置；内置 VirtualHeaderView：未启用过滤，显示 geometry 中全部可见 section。
defaults.en: The interface stores no shared configuration; built-in VirtualHeaderView: No filter; displays all visible sections in the geometry.

entries.comment: Shows every section again (no pane filter).

documentation.zh: 移除表头 section 的窗格过滤限制。
documentation.en: Remove the pane filter restricting header sections.

entries.comment:
Horizontal offset of the pane's own content (§43 "advanced panes").

A pane renderer packs the columns of its own pane from the pane's left
edge and shifts them by \a offset: 0 keeps a frozen pane pinned, the scroll
group's offset places a scrolling pane that is not the primary one, and
kFollowGeometryOffset (the default) keeps the renderer on HeaderGeometry's
committed position plus its viewport offset - which is what a whole-table
header and the primary scrolling pane use.

documentation.zh: 设置表头窗格的滚动偏移以跟随对应内容区域。
documentation.en: Set the header pane offset to follow its corresponding content pane.

defaults.zh: 接口本身不保存统一配置；内置 VirtualHeaderView：kFollowGeometryOffset；跟随 HeaderGeometry 的 viewportOffset，初始为 0。
defaults.en: The interface stores no shared configuration; built-in VirtualHeaderView: kFollowGeometryOffset; follows HeaderGeometry viewportOffset, initially 0.

entries.comment:
Visual geometry animation of a section move (§23/§24).

A renderer that places its own sections can slide a moved section to its
committed position instead of teleporting. VirtualTableView's body widgets
follow visual positions according to its column and row following settings,
both enabled by default; geometry queries use the committed HeaderGeometry.
A renderer that cannot do this - the native QHeaderView adapter, whose
placement and painting belong to Qt - ignores both calls and keeps its
immediate behaviour; the header and the body then simply agree at once.

documentation.zh: 设置section 动画开关。
documentation.en: Set the section animation setting.

defaults.zh: 接口本身不保存统一配置；内置 VirtualHeaderView：true
defaults.en: The interface stores no shared configuration; built-in VirtualHeaderView: true

entries.comment: Duration of the visual transition; 0 means "no animation".

documentation.zh: 设置section 动画时长（毫秒）。
documentation.en: Set the section animation duration in milliseconds.

defaults.zh: 接口本身不保存统一配置；内置 VirtualHeaderView：300 ms
defaults.en: The interface stores no shared configuration; built-in VirtualHeaderView: 300 ms

entries.comment:
Tells the renderer whether the *next* committed order change is one it should
show as a transition (§23/§24).

A committed order change is applied immediately by default: code that reorders
columns (or the model does it) gets the new order at once, never an animation
nobody asked for. The view sets this around an explicitly animated move
(`VirtualTableView::moveColumn(..., Animate)`), and a renderer that drives a
gesture itself - the widget header's drag - sets it after its single commit.
The flag is one-shot: the renderer consumes it with the next relayout.

documentation.zh: 设置 section 移动的动画位置，供内容与表头同步。
documentation.en: Set animated section movement for synchronized content and header positioning.

defaults.zh: 接口本身不保存统一配置；内置 VirtualHeaderView：false
defaults.en: The interface stores no shared configuration; built-in VirtualHeaderView: false

entries.signature: virtual bool sectionVisualX(int logicalIndex, int *viewportX) const;
entries.comment:
Where a section is *drawn* while the renderer is showing a position other
than the committed one: the dragged section of a preview, or a section
sliding to the order that was just committed.

HeaderGeometry stays the single source of truth - the body, the scroll bar,
hit testing and every query read it and only it - so a renderer that moves
its own sections has to be able to *report* the visual position. That is
what these three hooks are for, and they are what lets a view put the body's
column widgets on the same frame instead of jumping at the commit
(VirtualTableView::setColumnFollowsHeaderVisual()).

Fills \a viewportX with the x the section is drawn at, in viewport
coordinates (the space of ColumnGeometry::viewportX), and returns true.
Returns false - "ask the committed geometry" - for a section that is hidden,
not materialized, or when the renderer has no visual state at all (idle, or
a renderer whose placement belongs to Qt, like the native adapter).

documentation.zh: 返回section 在视口中的位置；视觉查询可包含动画位置。
documentation.en: Return the section viewport position; visual queries may include animation.

entries.comment:
True while this renderer draws at least one section away from its committed
position (a drag preview or a running transition). A view only mirrors the
sections while this is true, so an idle header costs nothing.

documentation.zh: 判断是否存在区别于静态列几何的视觉位置。
documentation.en: Check whether visual section positions differ from static geometry.

entries.comment:
Installs the callback the renderer invokes every time it places its sections
on a visual position - every animation frame, plus the frame that settles
back onto the committed geometry. It runs while the layout is still being
applied, so a listener that moves widgets does not flicker.

Pass an empty function to detach. Renderers without visual state ignore it.

documentation.zh: 提供 section 动画或特殊布局的视觉几何查询回调。
documentation.en: Supply a callback for section visual geometry during animation or custom layout.

defaults.zh: 接口本身不保存统一配置；内置 VirtualHeaderView：空回调；表格安装表头时注册同步回调。
defaults.en: The interface stores no shared configuration; built-in VirtualHeaderView: Empty callback; the table registers its synchronization callback when installing the header.

entries.comment:
The model's *items* changed identity without changing the section set: a row (or
column) was moved, inserted or removed, so the label a materialized section shows
belongs to a different item now. A renderer that caches what the label model said -
the default label adapter does - has to re-read it here; a renderer that lays its
sections out from the geometry alone ignores this.

The section *count* changes go through setGeometryModel()/the geometry's own
signals, so this is only about the text/state of the sections that already exist.

documentation.zh: 从标签模型重新读取表头文字并更新物化 section。
documentation.en: Reload header labels from the label model and update materialized sections.

entries.comment:
Colour the current style paints a header section separator with (probed by rendering a
small section and reading its edge pixel). The pane boundary lines and the built-in
section widgets use it, so every line that separates two sections - in either axis and
in the body - is the style's line instead of a guessed palette role.

\a context supplies the style and the palette (pass the view or a widget in it).

documentation.zh: 返回表头 section 分割线的有效颜色。
documentation.en: Return the effective header section separator color.

types.name: HeaderWidgetAdapter
types.comment:
Adapter of the section widgets of a VirtualHeaderView (architecture document
§18). Same contract as WidgetAdapter: the recycler creates/destroys widgets,
a pooled widget keeps no identity, and bindSection() has to be able to run
repeatedly on the same widget.

documentation.zh: 销毁 HeaderWidgetAdapter 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
documentation.en: Destroy HeaderWidgetAdapter and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

entries.comment: Classifies a section into a recycler pool (one pool by default).

documentation.zh: 返回复用类型标识。只有结构兼容的控件才应使用同一个类型值。
documentation.en: Return the recycling type identifier. Only structurally compatible widgets should share a type.

documentation.zh: 在 parent 下创建表头 section 控件，数据由 bindSection 填充。
documentation.en: Create a header section widget under parent; bindSection supplies its data.

entries.comment:
Tells the adapter which model the labels come from.

Called by VirtualHeaderView::setLabelModel() (with nullptr when the header drops its
model), so an adapter that captures the model does not
keep a second, stale copy of it: the header owns the model reference, the adapter is
told what it is. The default does nothing: an adapter that reads the model through
its own reference keeps working.

documentation.zh: 设置表头文本模型。
documentation.en: Set the header label model.

defaults.zh: 基类默认不执行操作、不保存引用；具体 adapter 决定绑定行为。
defaults.en: The base implementation does nothing and stores no reference; concrete adapters define binding behavior.

entries.comment:
Tells the adapter which header geometry the sections are laid out with.

Symmetric to setLabelModel(): a section widget that draws sort state
(`sortIndicatorSection()` / `sortIndicatorOrder()`) or reads a column width otherwise
has to capture the geometry somewhere, and `VirtualHeaderView::setGeometryModel()` is a
public, replaceable collaborator. Called by that setter, by `setAdapter()` (with the
geometry the header already has) and with nullptr when the header drops the geometry or
the geometry is destroyed - so an adapter that stores it can hold a plain pointer or a
`QPointer` and never has to guess. The default does nothing.

documentation.zh: 设置表头 section 几何模型。
documentation.en: Set the header section geometry model.

defaults.zh: 基类默认不执行操作、不保存引用；具体 adapter 决定绑定行为。
defaults.en: The base implementation does nothing and stores no reference; concrete adapters define binding behavior.

entries.comment:
Fills \a widget with the data of \a logicalIndex; called before the widget
is shown and every time the section widget is reused. It is also called
again for a widget that is *already* bound when the state of its section
changes (a renamed column, a column inserted/removed/moved, a new sort
indicator), so the section UI must be rebuildable from scratch here - that
is the only "state changed" hook a renderer gets.

documentation.zh: 将表头逻辑 section 的标签和状态绑定到控件。
documentation.en: Bind a logical header section's label and state to its widget.

entries.comment:
Detaches \a widget from \a logicalIndex (stop timers, animations,
subscriptions; clear the content). Animation state must never leak into
the section the widget is bound to next (§19). This is a *recycle* hook:
it is called when the widget leaves the materialized set, not before a
re-bind of the same section.

documentation.zh: 解除表头 section 绑定并清理可复用控件的旧状态。
documentation.en: Unbind a header section and clear obsolete state on its reusable widget.

types.name: EditRequestContext
types.comment:
Snapshot for an adapter-owned edit request. Pointers and binding.index are
intended for this callback; use QPointer/QPersistentModelIndex for a popup.

entries.comment:
Full item/cell bounds in each coordinate system, not clipped to visibility.
All rectangles use Qt logical pixels; do not multiply by devicePixelRatio.

Call after business confirmation or dismissal. Safe to copy and call later;
an expired request cannot end a newer session. Does not commit model data.

documentation.zh: adapter 自行处理 Popup 编辑的定位与生命周期上下文。矩形是未按可见区域裁剪的完整项范围，单位为 Qt 逻辑像素；跨回调保留对象／索引使用 QPointer / QPersistentModelIndex。
documentation.en: Positioning and lifecycle context for adapter-owned Popup editing. Rectangles are full unclipped item bounds in Qt logical pixels. Retain objects/indexes across callbacks using QPointer / QPersistentModelIndex.

members.name: binding

types.name: ItemEditorAdapter
types.comment:
Optional overlay editors shared by row and cell adapters. The model must
expose ItemIsEditable and ItemIsEnabled. Editors are not pooled.

documentation.zh: 销毁 ItemEditorAdapter 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
documentation.en: Destroy ItemEditorAdapter and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

entries.signature: virtual EditTriggers editTriggers(const QModelIndex &index, EditTriggers defaults) const;
entries.comment: Overrides view defaults per index. NoEditTriggers permits explicit editing only.

documentation.zh: 按 index 覆盖视图默认编辑触发条件；默认返回 defaults。NoEditTriggers 只禁用自动手势，显式 edit(index) 仍可用。
documentation.en: Override view edit triggers for index; the default returns defaults. NoEditTriggers disables automatic gestures while explicit edit(index) remains available.

notes.zh: 视图默认 DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed（F2）。adapter 可按 index 覆盖；按钮或外部操作直接调用 view->edit(index)。模型需设置 ItemIsEditable 和 ItemIsEnabled。
notes.en: The view defaults to DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed (F2). Adapters can override per index. Buttons and external actions call view->edit(index). The model item must have ItemIsEditable and ItemIsEnabled.

examples.zh: 以下重载放在已有的行/单元格 adapter 类中：第 0 列单击编辑，第 1 列沿用视图设置，其余列只允许显式 edit(index)。模型编辑权限仍然有效。
examples.en: Place this override inside an existing row/cell adapter: column 0 edits on a single click, column 1 inherits view settings, and other columns require explicit edit(index). Model editing permissions still apply.

entries.comment:
Called after permissions and positioning, before createEditor(). Return true
to handle the request (for example with a business popup), or false to use
the normal overlay editor. Defaults to false. Handled requests participate
in framework cancellation; call context.finish when business editing ends.

documentation.zh: 返回 true 表示适配器接管编辑（例如 Popup），返回 false 进入 createEditor。context 提供 viewport/view/global 矩形；业务结束调用 finish，不会自动写模型。
documentation.en: Return true to handle editing in the adapter, such as a Popup, or false to use createEditor. The context supplies viewport/view/global rectangles. Call finish when done; it does not write model data.

entries.comment:
Cancels an adapter-owned request without committing. Close/reject the popup
here; defer its deletion until the current event returns. May be called
during editRequest() if a nested event invalidates the request. The index
may be invalid during teardown. Defaults to no action.

documentation.zh: 取消适配器接管的编辑请求；在此关闭 Popup，不提交数据。索引可能失效，控件销毁应延迟到当前事件结束。
documentation.en: Cancel an adapter-owned edit request. Close the Popup without committing. The index may be invalid; defer widget destruction until the current event returns.

entries.comment:
Creates an editor under the supplied clipping host. Null disables editing.
Composite editors should set a focus proxy to their input widget.

documentation.zh: 在给定裁剪宿主下创建覆盖编辑控件；返回 nullptr 表示不创建。组合编辑器应将焦点代理指向实际输入控件。
documentation.en: Create an overlay editor under the supplied clipping host; return nullptr to decline. Composite editors should set a focus proxy to the actual input.

examples.zh: 以下三个方法放在用于整数项的现有 adapter 类内，需包含 QSpinBox 和 QAbstractItemModel。原值保存于 Qt::UserRole + 1；bindWidget()/bindCellWidget() 从同一 role 读取并格式化。若混用不同编辑器，应先按列或类型分支，再进行 static_cast。
examples.en: Place these three methods inside an existing adapter for integer items; include QSpinBox and QAbstractItemModel. Raw values live in Qt::UserRole + 1; bindWidget()/bindCellWidget() reads that same role for display formatting. When mixing editor types, branch by column/type before static_cast.

documentation.zh: 将模型值载入编辑器。默认读取 EditRole 并写入 Qt USER 属性；自定义 role 时与 commitEditorData 成对重载。
documentation.en: Load model data into the editor. The default reads EditRole into the Qt USER property; override together with commitEditorData for a custom role.

defaults.zh: 无固定初始文本；默认读取 context.index 的 Qt::EditRole，写入 editor 的 USER 属性。
defaults.en: No fixed initial text; the default reads Qt::EditRole from context.index and writes it to the editor USER property.

Raw values live in Qt::UserRole + 1; bindWidget()/bindCellWidget() reads that same role for display formatting. When mixing editor types, branch by column/type before static_cast.

entries.signature:
virtual void updateEditorGeometry(QWidget *editor, const QRect &rect,
                                      const ItemBindingContext &context);
entries.comment:
Uses the entire cell in parent coordinates by default. Tree adapters can
inset rect by context.indentationWidth and/or context.branchWidth to leave
tree decoration uncovered; clamp the inset to rect.width().

documentation.zh: 更新覆盖编辑器几何；默认使用父坐标系中的完整 cell 矩形。树可按 context.indentationWidth / branchWidth 内缩，注意限制到 rect 宽度内。
documentation.en: Update overlay editor geometry; the default uses the full cell rectangle in parent coordinates. For trees, inset by context.indentationWidth / branchWidth, clamped to rect width.

entries.signature:
virtual bool commitEditorData(QWidget *editor, QAbstractItemModel *model,
                                  const ItemBindingContext &context);
entries.comment: Writes the Qt USER property to EditRole. False keeps the editor open.

documentation.zh: 把编辑器内容写回模型；默认 Qt USER 属性写入 EditRole。返回 false 保持编辑器打开，可用于校验失败。
documentation.en: Write editor data to the model; the default writes the Qt USER property to EditRole. Return false to keep editing, for example after validation failure.

examples.zh: 以下三个方法放在用于整数项的现有 adapter 类内，需包含 QSpinBox 和 QAbstractItemModel。原值保存于 Qt::UserRole + 1；bindWidget()/bindCellWidget() 从同一 role 读取并格式化。若混用不同编辑器，应先按列或类型分支，再进行 static_cast。
examples.en: Place these three methods inside an existing adapter for integer items; include QSpinBox and QAbstractItemModel. Raw values live in Qt::UserRole + 1; bindWidget()/bindCellWidget() reads that same role for display formatting. When mixing editor types, branch by column/type before static_cast.

entries.comment:
Defaults to deleteLater(). The index may be invalid during model teardown.
Do not commit data here. Overrides should also defer deletion until the
current editor event has returned, as with QStyledItemDelegate.

documentation.zh: 清理编辑器，默认 deleteLater；不要在这里提交数据。模型销毁期间索引可能已无效。
documentation.en: Dispose of the editor, using deleteLater by default. Do not commit here; the index may already be invalid during model teardown.

types.name: ItemPane
types.comment:
One horizontal band ("pane") of a view: the row direction of §31, specified in
docs/history/row-freezing.md.

The frozen panes are pinned to the top/bottom edge and never scroll; the
scrolling pane between them follows the vertical offset. A view without frozen
rows has exactly one pane covering the viewport, so nothing changes.

Like TablePane, an ItemPane never owns a row height: it only says which rows it
shows and where it sits. The row geometry keeps coming from ListLayout/SizeIndex.

documentation.zh: 纵向 pane 的位置和滚动方式。
documentation.en: Position and scrolling of a vertical pane.

members.zh: 顶部冻结行。
members.en: Top frozen rows.

members.name: Scrollable
members.zh: 跟随纵向偏移，ItemPane 默认值。
members.en: Follow vertical offsets; the ItemPane default.

members.name: FrozenBottom
members.zh: 底部冻结行。
members.en: Bottom frozen rows.

Where the pane lives inside the viewport (y and height matter; the width is
the viewport width).

documentation.en: Check whether the pane or specified row/column belongs to a frozen region.

types.name: LabelHeaderAdapter

The header adapter of the built-in label header: one label per section, taken

override labelText() or
sortOrderFor() to change what a section shows without writing a section widget.

types.name: LayoutPolicy
types.comment:
Geometry strategy of a virtual view.

The kernel only talks to this interface: it never assumes that items are
rows or that the scrolling axis is vertical. List/Table/Tree therefore share
one virtualization kernel and differ in their layout/visibility strategy.

documentation.zh: 销毁 LayoutPolicy 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
documentation.en: Destroy LayoutPolicy and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

Linear (list) layout: items are stacked along one axis.

The layout owns a SizeIndex, which decouples the layout from the actual
size model: FixedSizeIndex for fixed-height content, BlockSizeIndex for
dynamic heights.

types.name: ScrollMapper
types.comment:
Maps between the 64-bit logical scroll space and the int-based QScrollBar
range.

The logical content extent of a virtual view may exceed INT_MAX pixels
(millions of dynamic-height rows). QScrollBar only offers an int range, so
this mapper compresses the logical space into the scrollbar range.

Compression is *windowed*: the mapper keeps an anchor pair
(logicalOffset, scrollBarValue) that corresponds to the current viewport
position. Conversions close to the anchor are therefore at least as precise
as the scrollbar step itself, and value -> offset -> value round trips are
exact. This is what keeps the scrollbar stable (no thumb jitter) while
dragging and while the height of the content changes.

(The architecture document calls the two directions toScrollbar()/
toLogical(); the API names are toScrollBarValue()/toLogicalOffset().)

entries.comment:
Largest scrollbar value span used when the content does not fit into an
int range. Kept below INT_MAX to leave room for Qt's own arithmetic.

types.name: BlockSizeIndex
types.comment:
Size index for dynamic content, backed by fixed-capacity blocks.

Each block stores one *base* size plus a sparse, sorted table of exceptions:
the rows whose measured size differs from that base. Rows that were never
measured therefore cost nothing at all, so uniform content keeps one entry
per block instead of 4 bytes per row (ten million rows: ~40 MB before, well
under 1 MB now). A measured size is never rewritten by a later estimate
change, nor by inserts/removals of other rows.

A lazily rebuilt prefix table over the block sums provides O(log B) block
lookup (B = block count); the row inside a block is found by binary
searching its exceptions and then walking the (usually empty) remainder.
blockForRow()/indexAt()/setSize() are O(log B + E_b) with E_b the exceptions
below the row, setSize() additionally pays the vector shift inside the
block, insert() is O(log B + capacity) and remove() O(B + capacity).
Splitting a block above 2 * capacity and merging neighbours that fit into
one capacity keeps E_b <= 2 * capacity, so the worst case stays the
O(log B + capacity) of the previous representation while the common case (a
block nobody ever measured) is O(log B). This matches the "first version may
be simpler than O(log N)" guidance of the architecture document; the public
API is ready to be backed by a Fenwick tree or an implicit balanced tree
later on.

offset, so scrolling can never hide a frozen column.

resize or a change of the frozen sets, exactly like the other derived
caches of the table.

frozen column sets (the default three panes), so setFrozenColumns() stays
the shorthand for the common case.

Every pane of the list is kept - also one that currently has no visible
column - so panes() and paneSpecs() stay index compatible.

The list is normalized: a column belongs to the first pane that names it
(later panes lose it, negative indexes are dropped), a negative scroll
group becomes 0, and a group whose panes are not neighbours is kept as
written but warned about - each problem at most once per call, and only
when the list really changes.

types.name: TableSpan
types.comment:
Span of one cell, in model coordinates (architecture document §43 "spans",
see docs/history/spans.md).

A span is *projection information only*: it never carries a column width or a
row height of its own. The merged rectangle is always derived from the
committed HeaderGeometry and the row layout, so dragging a column, moving a
column, hiding a column or changing a row height can never make a span and
the rest of the table disagree.

documentation.en: Check whether a cell is covered by another anchor, or whether the range is merged.

types.comment:
Map based provider: the application registers the anchors it wants merged.

If a structural change makes two spans overlap, the anchor earlier in the
current sibling row/column order survives and the other span is removed.

types.name: TreeVisibilityIndex
types.comment:
Maps a QAbstractItemModel tree onto the flat list of *visible* rows.

This is the Tree counterpart of SizeIndex: the virtualization kernel works
on visible rows, and the tree only differs by how a visible row maps back to
a QModelIndex (plus depth and branch state).

Performance contract:
- expand()/collapse() splice the flat visible list and traverse the model
only for the expanded subtree; the whole tree is never re-flattened. The
splice moves the rows below the anchor once (memmove - QModelIndex is a value
type) and only writes the new sub-tree. Moving the tail remains linear in
the number of subsequent visible rows,
- indexAtVisibleRow() is O(1),
- visibleRowForIndex()/isVisible() are O(depth x log(siblings)): the row of an
item is the sum, over its ancestors, of "1 + the visible sub-tree sizes of
the preceding siblings". Those sizes live in one Fenwick tree per expanded
parent (see BranchBlock), so a wide parent costs 4 bytes per child and
nothing is rebuilt when the expansion state changes,
- no per-row lookup table at all: a table keyed by the model index *value*
would have to be rebuilt on every expand/collapse (O(visible rows)); using
QPersistentModelIndex keys would instead register one persistent index per
visible row with the model,
- a structural change rebuilds the visible list (O(visible rows)), an
expand()/collapse() only walks its own sub-tree and pokes the ancestors on
the path - the model is never walked for a collapsed sub-tree,
- model mutations (insert/remove/move/layoutChanged) rebuild the visible
list while keeping the expansion state; modelReset clears it too.

documentation.zh: 收起指定节点。 子孙可见性由祖先展开状态共同决定；视图启用动画时由框架驱动真实控件布局。
documentation.en: Collapse the specified node. Descendant visibility also depends on ancestor expansion. Views with animation enabled drive real widget layout.

entries.comment:
Expands \a index and every branch below it (QTreeView's `*`). The
sub-tree is walked once and the visible rows are rebuilt once.

documentation.zh: 递归展开指定节点及要求深度内的后代。大树应限制深度，避免一次显示过多项目。
documentation.en: Expand the specified node and descendants to the requested depth. Limit depth for large trees to avoid exposing excessive items at once.

documentation.zh: 设置指定节点展开状态。
documentation.en: Set the expanded state of the specified node.

defaults.en: false; the initial expansion set is empty.

documentation.zh: 切换指定节点的展开状态。 子孙可见性由祖先展开状态共同决定；视图启用动画时由框架驱动真实控件布局。
documentation.en: Toggle the specified node expansion state. Descendant visibility also depends on ancestor expansion. Views with animation enabled drive real widget layout.

documentation.zh: 判断指定节点或当前 branch 状态是否展开。
documentation.en: Check whether the specified node or current branch state is expanded.

entries.comment: Collapses every item and rebuilds (top level items stay visible).

documentation.zh: 收起当前树范围内的全部节点；批量收起不等同逐项调用带动画的 collapse。
documentation.en: Collapse all nodes in the current tree scope; bulk collapse is not equivalent to invoking animated collapse on every item.

documentation.zh: 返回已展开节点数。
documentation.en: Return the expanded node count.

entries.comment:
Number of model queries (rowCount/index/parent) since the last
resetModelQueryCount(); used by tests to prove that expand/collapse does
not walk the whole tree.

documentation.zh: 返回模型查询次数。
documentation.en: Return the model query count.

documentation.zh: 清零模型查询计数，用于下一段诊断测量。
documentation.en: Reset the model-query counter for the next diagnostic interval.

types.name: GridLinePlacement
types.comment:
Position of item grid lines when a nonzero gap separates adjacent items.
Zero spacing always uses one shared trailing boundary.

documentation.zh: 项间距中的分割线位置。零间距时只使用一个共享边界；支持范围需看具体视图。
documentation.en: Grid-line placement inside gaps. Zero spacing uses a single shared boundary; support depends on the view.

members.name: SpacingCenter
members.zh: 间距中心画线，始终穿过另一方向间距；外侧补半间距居中。
members.en: Draw at gap centers, always crossing perpendicular gaps; outer half-gaps center content.

members.name: SpacingEdges
members.zh: 间距两侧画线，支持的视图可配置是否跨过另一方向间距。
members.en: Draw at both gap edges; supporting views can configure perpendicular-gap crossing.

types.name: OptionalPoint
types.comment: A point that can be omitted, including on C++14 toolchains.

entries.comment: Starts without a point; value_or() returns its fallback.

documentation.zh: 构造没有值的可选坐标，value_or() 将返回调用方的备用坐标。
documentation.en: Construct an empty optional point; value_or() returns the caller-provided fallback.

entries.comment: Stores any coordinate, including the origin and negative coordinates.

documentation.zh: 保存传入坐标并标记为有值；原点和负坐标同样有效。
documentation.en: Store the supplied point and mark it present; origin and negative coordinates are valid.

entries.comment: Replaces the stored point and marks it present.

documentation.zh: 保存给定 QPoint 并将可选值标记为有效。
documentation.en: Store the supplied QPoint and mark the optional as engaged.

entries.comment: Whether a point was explicitly supplied.

documentation.zh: 判断兼容可选值是否包含有效值。
documentation.en: Check whether the compatibility optional contains a value.

entries.comment: Returns the stored point, or the fallback when omitted.

documentation.zh: 有值时返回保存值，无值时返回给定默认值。
documentation.en: Return the stored value when present, otherwise the supplied default.

entries.comment: Clears the supplied point so the fallback is used again.

documentation.zh: 重建尺寸或布局索引的项目集合，使用给定数量与初始尺寸。
documentation.en: Reinitialize the item collection in the size or layout index using the supplied count and initial sizes.

types.name: DragOptions
types.comment: Optional screenshot source and pointer position for a manually started drag.

entries.comment: Uses dragSourceWidget() when null; ownership stays with the caller.

Widget-local logical pixels; empty uses the default view preview when no widget is given,
or captures the whole explicitly supplied widget.
Nonempty rectangles are clipped to the widget's bounds.
Anchors the preview at the mouse position by default; false centres it.

Explicit global press position, including (0, 0). When omitted, the view
uses its matching recorded press or the cursor position at drag entry.

documentation.zh: 手动 startDrag() 的预览与热点选项。默认使用视图生成的预览，并以按下位置作为热点。
documentation.en: Preview and hotspot options for manual startDrag(). Defaults to a view-generated preview anchored at the press position.

members.name: previewWidget
members.zh: 截图来源控件，默认 nullptr 使用视图默认来源；不转移所有权。
members.en: Capture source; nullptr uses the view default; no ownership transfer.

members.name: previewRect
members.zh: 来源控件局部截图范围，默认空矩形使用默认预览或完整指定控件；非空范围裁剪到控件边界。
members.en: Widget-local capture bounds; empty uses the default preview or whole explicit widget; nonempty bounds are clipped to the widget.

members.name: usePressPosition
members.zh: 使用鼠标位置作为热点，默认 true；false 时居中。
members.en: Anchor at the pointer; defaults to true; false centers the preview.

members.name: globalPressPosition
members.zh: 可选全局按下位置，默认未提供，回退到匹配按下记录或当前光标；(0,0) 也是有效显式值。
members.en: Optional global press position; absent by default, falling back to a matching press or current cursor; (0,0) is valid.

types.name: ItemBindingContext
types.comment:
Data and metadata supplied to adapter binding callbacks.

`index` remains the identity of the materialized item. `rowData` is read from
`itemDataRole()` using the row's canonical column (column 0 for tables), so
adapters do not have to unpack a business structure from every cell index.

entries.comment: Logical model column for tables (including row widgets); -1 for lists/trees.
Node depth relative to the displayed root; flat items have depth 0.

Ancestor indentation before the node's own branch cell, in Qt logical pixels.
Layout widths before viewport/cell clipping; zero for non-tree items and
tree-table columns other than logical column zero.

Width reserved for the node's own branch cell, not the icon's pixel size.
Zero when that cell is omitted; hiding only the indicator keeps its space.

documentation.zh: 绑定／编辑回调的项数据与布局元信息。index 标识当前项；rowData 按 itemDataRole() 从规范列读取，表格通常为第 0 列。
documentation.en: Item data and layout metadata for binding/editing callbacks. index identifies the item; rowData is read with itemDataRole() from the canonical column, normally column 0 for tables.

members.name: index
members.zh: 当前项或单元格索引，默认无效。
members.en: Current item/cell index; initially invalid.

members.name: rowData
members.zh: 整行／节点业务数据，默认无效 QVariant。
members.en: Row/node payload; initially an invalid QVariant.

members.name: logicalColumn
members.zh: 表格逻辑列号；列表／树为 -1，默认 -1。
members.en: Logical table column; -1 for lists/trees; initially -1.

members.name: depth
members.zh: 相对显示根的深度；平面项为 0，默认 -1。
members.en: Depth relative to the displayed root; 0 for flat items; initially -1.

members.name: indentationWidth
members.zh: 未裁剪的祖先缩进宽度，默认 0；非树项和树表非第 0 列为 0。
members.en: Unclipped ancestor indentation width; initially 0; 0 for non-tree items and nonzero tree-table columns.

members.name: branchWidth
members.zh: 节点自身 branch 格宽度，不是图标大小；默认 0，仅隐藏图标仍保留此宽度。
members.en: Node branch-cell width, not icon size; initially 0; hiding only the icon retains the width.

types.name: PaneSeparatorStyle
types.comment:
Look of the line that separates two panes (§31). Shared by the column panes
(VirtualTableView) and the row panes (VirtualItemView), so both boundaries look
the same.

entries.comment:
Pixels the line occupies inside the preceding pane (1 = the default hair
line, 0 hides the boundary line, 3 = a thick divider).

Explicit colour. An invalid colour (the default) means "use the colour the
current style paints separators with", so the boundary line matches the
lines between items instead of a guessed palette role.
Solid by default; every line style uses width as its physical-pixel stroke width.

documentation.zh: 判断节点在当前展开层级中是否可见，不等于已物化到屏幕内。
documentation.en: Check visibility under the current expansion hierarchy; this does not imply on-screen materialization.

entries.comment: Colour to paint with: the explicit one, or \a styleSeparatorColor.

documentation.zh: 返回样式解析后的有效颜色。
documentation.en: Return the effective resolved style color.

entries.signature: friend bool operator==(const PaneSeparatorStyle &lhs, const PaneSeparatorStyle &rhs);

documentation.zh: 比较两个记录的值是否相等；不比较对象地址。
documentation.en: Compare the values of two records, rather than their object addresses.

entries.signature: friend bool operator!=(const PaneSeparatorStyle &lhs, const PaneSeparatorStyle &rhs);

documentation.zh: 比较两个记录的值是否相等；不比较对象地址。
documentation.en: Compare the values of two records, rather than their object addresses.

documentation.zh: 冻结行／列边界样式，与普通分割线分别配置。默认 1 物理像素实线，颜色跟随样式分割线。
documentation.en: Frozen row/column boundary style, independent of ordinary grid lines. Defaults to a 1-physical-pixel solid stroke using the style separator color.

members.name: width
members.zh: 线宽默认 1；0 隐藏边界线。
members.en: Stroke width defaults to 1; 0 hides the separator.

members.name: color
members.zh: 显式颜色，默认无效 QColor 时跟随样式。
members.en: Explicit color; initially invalid QColor, using the style color.

members.name: lineStyle
members.zh: 线型，默认 Qt::SolidLine，可配置虚线。
members.en: Pen style; defaults to Qt::SolidLine; supports dashed lines.

types.name: VisibleRange
types.comment: Inclusive range of item indices (visible rows, visible columns, ...).

documentation.zh: 判断当前索引、范围或几何记录是否可用；使用几何或访问模型前先检查无效结果。
documentation.en: Check whether the index, range or geometry record is usable before accessing geometry or model data.

documentation.zh: 判断指定索引、行或位置是否在当前范围内。
documentation.en: Check whether an index, row or position is contained in this range.

documentation.zh: 返回布局、索引或范围中的项目数量。
documentation.en: Return the item count in the layout, index or range.

entries.signature:
static VisibleRange expanded(qsizetype coreFirst, qsizetype coreLast, qsizetype before,
                                 qsizetype after, qsizetype upperBound);
entries.comment: Range widened by \a before/\a after items, clamped to [0, upperBound).

documentation.zh: 在核心可见区间前后加入 before/after 预加载范围，并限制到 upperBound；返回扩展后的区间。
documentation.en: Expand a core visible range by before/after overscan, clamp it to upperBound and return the expanded range.

documentation.zh: 包含首尾的项序号区间。默认 first=last=-1 表示无效／空区间。
documentation.en: Inclusive item-index range. Initially first=last=-1 denotes an invalid/empty range.

members.name: first
members.zh: 第一个项序号，初始 -1。
members.en: First item index; initially -1.

members.name: last
members.zh: 最后一个项序号（包含），初始 -1。
members.en: Last item index, inclusive; initially -1.

entries.comment: Default model role used by VirtualItemView for one complete row/node payload.

Identifier used to classify the widgets produced by a WidgetAdapter.

The kernel only compares widget types for equality: it never interprets
them. An adapter is free to return the same value for every index (a single
pool) or one value per business row layout (several pools).
Widget type used when an adapter does not classify its widgets.

types.name: VirtualFlowTableView
types.comment:
Responsive item grid. Display columns share the viewport width; model rows
remain item identities when resizing moves items between display rows.
Use the cell height API below. Inherited size-index height setters are
unsupported. Automatic item-widget sizeHint measurement is disabled and cannot
be enabled; attempts to use either unsupported configuration report a warning.
setAutoHeightEnabled() fixes the whole view to its responsive grid height.
setAutoHeightMaximumHeight() optionally caps it; zero means no height limit.
The parent layout does not shrink the computed height.

documentation.zh: Flow 网格高度策略，使用专用 cell 尺寸接口配置。
documentation.en: Flow grid height strategy, configured with dedicated cell-size APIs.

members.name: Fixed
members.zh: 使用 setCellHeight() 的统一高度。
members.en: Use the uniform setCellHeight() value.

members.name: AspectRatio
members.zh: 按实际 cell 宽度和 setCellAspectRatio() 的宽／高比计算。
members.en: Compute from actual cell width and the setCellAspectRatio() width/height ratio.

documentation.zh: 构造 VirtualFlowTableView；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
documentation.en: Construct VirtualFlowTableView with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

documentation.zh: 连接新的数据模型并更新布局、选择与物化状态；模型生命周期需覆盖视图使用期间。不要用重复 setModel 代替数据变更通知。
documentation.en: Connect a new data model and update layout, selection and materialization. Keep the model alive while in use; do not replace change notifications with repeated setModel calls.

defaults.en: nullptr; no model is attached initially.

entries.comment: Shows the first-column children of this model index.

documentation.zh: 设置展示子项所属模型根索引。
documentation.en: Set the model root index whose children are displayed.

defaults.zh: 无效 QModelIndex，显示模型根级。
defaults.en: Invalid QModelIndex; the model root is displayed.

documentation.zh: 返回展示子项所属模型根索引。
documentation.en: Return the model root index whose children are displayed.

defaults.zh: 无效 QModelIndex，显示模型根级。
defaults.en: Invalid QModelIndex; the model root is displayed.

entries.comment: Preferred range. Filling wins when spacing/narrow sizes make it infeasible.

documentation.zh: 设置单元格或项目的宽度上下限，影响换行和自动列数计算。
documentation.en: Set cell or item width bounds used by wrapping and automatic column-count calculations.

defaults.zh: minimum = 100，maximum = 200 逻辑像素；最终列宽由视口和列数决定。
defaults.en: minimum = 100, maximum = 200 logical pixels; effective column width depends on viewport width and column count.

examples.zh: 流式网格按 16:9 宽高比布局。view 为已设置模型和 adapter 的 VirtualFlowTableView；宽高比为宽/高，需同时切换 AspectRatio 模式，不能使用继承的 setUniformItemHeight() 替代。
examples.en: Lay out a flow grid at a 16:9 aspect ratio. view is a VirtualFlowTableView with a model and adapter. The ratio is width/height; also select AspectRatio mode rather than using inherited setUniformItemHeight().

documentation.zh: 返回单元格或项目宽度下限或上限。
documentation.en: Return the minimum or maximum cell or item width.

documentation.zh: 返回单元格或项目宽度下限或上限。
documentation.en: Return the minimum or maximum cell or item width.

documentation.zh: 设置流式表格单元格高度模式。
documentation.en: Set the flow-table cell height mode.

examples.zh: 流式网格按 16:9 宽高比布局。view 为已设置模型和 adapter 的 VirtualFlowTableView；宽高比为宽/高，需同时切换 AspectRatio 模式，不能使用继承的 setUniformItemHeight() 替代。
examples.en: Lay out a flow grid at a 16:9 aspect ratio. view is a VirtualFlowTableView with a model and adapter. The ratio is width/height; also select AspectRatio mode rather than using inherited setUniformItemHeight().

documentation.zh: 返回流式表格单元格高度模式。
documentation.en: Return the flow-table cell height mode.

documentation.zh: 设置固定模式的单元格高度。
documentation.en: Set the cell height in fixed mode.

documentation.zh: 返回固定模式的单元格高度。
documentation.en: Return the cell height in fixed mode.

entries.comment: Ratio is width / height; nonpositive or nonfinite values are rejected.

documentation.zh: 设置单元格宽高比（宽 / 高）。
documentation.en: Set the cell aspect ratio (width / height).

examples.zh: 流式网格按 16:9 宽高比布局。view 为已设置模型和 adapter 的 VirtualFlowTableView；宽高比为宽/高，需同时切换 AspectRatio 模式，不能使用继承的 setUniformItemHeight() 替代。
examples.en: Lay out a flow grid at a 16:9 aspect ratio. view is a VirtualFlowTableView with a model and adapter. The ratio is width/height; also select AspectRatio mode rather than using inherited setUniformItemHeight().

documentation.zh: 返回单元格宽高比（宽 / 高）。
documentation.en: Return the cell aspect ratio (width / height).

documentation.zh: 设置内容列间距。
documentation.en: Set the spacing between content columns.

documentation.zh: 返回内容列间距。
documentation.en: Return the spacing between content columns.

documentation.zh: 设置行间距。
documentation.en: Set the spacing between rows.

entries.comment:
Center mode adds outer half-gaps inside the configured content margins.
Edge mode has no outer half-gaps.

documentation.zh: 设置间距中心或两侧分割线模式。
documentation.en: Set the grid line placement at spacing centers or edges.

notes.zh: 默认 SpacingCenter：在间距中心绘制，交叉线始终穿过间距，且外侧补半间距；零间距时不重复画线。SpacingEdges 在间距两侧绘制，只有这个模式允许控制是否穿过交叉间距。是否穿过表头使用单独开关。
notes.en: SpacingCenter is the default: lines run through gap centers, cross gaps unconditionally, and use outer half-gaps; zero spacing does not duplicate lines. SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

defaults.zh: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter；无间距时回退到项边界，不重复绘制。
defaults.en: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter; without spacing, lines fall back to item boundaries without duplicates.

documentation.zh: 设置内容四周外边距。
documentation.en: Set the margins around the content.

documentation.zh: 返回内容四周外边距。
documentation.en: Return the margins around the content.

entries.comment:
Colors row and column gaps; invalid colors restore the viewport background.
Content margins and absent cells retain the viewport background.

documentation.zh: 设置内容或表头间距背景颜色。
documentation.en: Set the content or header gap background color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；未指定间距色，随内容背景绘制，默认 QPalette::Base。
defaults.en: Invalid QColor; gaps follow the content background, QPalette::Base by default.

entries.comment: Built-in item backgrounds; business widgets should be transparent to show them.

documentation.zh: 设置hover 或选中背景绘制开关。
documentation.en: Set the hover or selection background painting setting.

defaults.zh: true；内置 hover / selection 背景启用。
defaults.en: true; built-in hover / selection backgrounds are enabled.

documentation.zh: 返回hover 或选中背景绘制开关。
documentation.en: Return the hover or selection background painting setting.

defaults.zh: true；内置 hover / selection 背景启用。
defaults.en: true; built-in hover / selection backgrounds are enabled.

entries.comment: Rounded shape stays within the item rectangle; spacing is never painted.

documentation.zh: 设置状态背景圆角半径。
documentation.en: Set the state background corner radius.

documentation.zh: 返回状态背景圆角半径。
documentation.en: Return the state background corner radius.

entries.comment: Separators remain visible at zero spacing and overlay business widgets.

documentation.zh: 设置纵向分割线可见性。
documentation.en: Set the vertical grid line visibility.

documentation.zh: 返回纵向分割线可见性。
documentation.en: Return the vertical grid line visibility.

documentation.zh: 设置横向分割线可见性。
documentation.en: Set the horizontal grid line visibility.

documentation.zh: 返回横向分割线可见性。
documentation.en: Return the horizontal grid line visibility.

entries.comment: Line widths are physical pixels, clamped to at least one. Invalid colors use palette Mid.

documentation.zh: 设置纵向分割线宽度。
documentation.en: Set the vertical grid line width.

defaults.zh: 1 像素；缩放与对齐遵循该分割线接口的规则。
defaults.en: 1 pixel; scaling and alignment follow this separator API.

documentation.zh: 返回纵向分割线宽度。
documentation.en: Return the vertical grid line width.

defaults.zh: 1 像素；缩放与对齐遵循该分割线接口的规则。
defaults.en: 1 pixel; scaling and alignment follow this separator API.

documentation.zh: 设置横向分割线宽度。
documentation.en: Set the horizontal grid line width.

defaults.zh: 1 像素；缩放与对齐遵循该分割线接口的规则。
defaults.en: 1 pixel; scaling and alignment follow this separator API.

documentation.zh: 返回横向分割线宽度。
documentation.en: Return the horizontal grid line width.

defaults.zh: 1 像素；缩放与对齐遵循该分割线接口的规则。
defaults.en: 1 pixel; scaling and alignment follow this separator API.

documentation.zh: 设置纵向分割线颜色。
documentation.en: Set the vertical grid line color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；绘制时使用 QPalette::Mid。

documentation.zh: 返回纵向分割线颜色。
documentation.en: Return the vertical grid line color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；绘制时使用 QPalette::Mid。

documentation.zh: 设置横向分割线颜色。
documentation.en: Set the horizontal grid line color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；绘制时使用 QPalette::Mid。

documentation.zh: 返回横向分割线颜色。
documentation.en: Return the horizontal grid line color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；绘制时使用 QPalette::Mid。

entries.comment:
SpacingEdges only: whether segments bridge crossing gaps (default true).
SpacingCenter always bridges gaps and ignores these setters.

documentation.zh: 设置两侧模式下纵向线穿过行间距开关。
documentation.en: Set the whether vertical lines cross row gaps in edge mode.

notes.zh: 默认 SpacingCenter：在间距中心绘制，交叉线始终穿过间距，且外侧补半间距；零间距时不重复画线。SpacingEdges 在间距两侧绘制，只有这个模式允许控制是否穿过交叉间距。是否穿过表头使用单独开关。
notes.en: SpacingCenter is the default: lines run through gap centers, cross gaps unconditionally, and use outer half-gaps; zero spacing does not duplicate lines. SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

defaults.zh: true；SpacingCenter 始终穿过间距，此开关仅在 SpacingEdges 生效。
defaults.en: true; SpacingCenter always crosses gaps; this switch only affects SpacingEdges.

documentation.zh: 返回两侧模式下纵向线穿过行间距开关。
documentation.en: Return the whether vertical lines cross row gaps in edge mode.

notes.zh: 默认 SpacingCenter：在间距中心绘制，交叉线始终穿过间距，且外侧补半间距；零间距时不重复画线。SpacingEdges 在间距两侧绘制，只有这个模式允许控制是否穿过交叉间距。是否穿过表头使用单独开关。
notes.en: SpacingCenter is the default: lines run through gap centers, cross gaps unconditionally, and use outer half-gaps; zero spacing does not duplicate lines. SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

defaults.zh: true；SpacingCenter 始终穿过间距，此开关仅在 SpacingEdges 生效。
defaults.en: true; SpacingCenter always crosses gaps; this switch only affects SpacingEdges.

types.name: VirtualHeaderView
types.declaration: class VIRTUALITEMVIEWS_EXPORT VirtualHeaderView : public QWidget, public HeaderViewInterface
types.comment:
QWidget based header (architecture document §17-§19), for both axes.

Instead of letting QStyle paint sections, every *materialized* section is a
real QWidget produced by a HeaderWidgetAdapter, so a header can carry badges,
progress, filter buttons, search fields or animated sort arrows. It
deliberately does not inherit QHeaderView: the paint/cache machinery of
QHeaderView and a child widget tree do not mix well.

The same class renders the column header (Qt::Horizontal, sections packed along
x) and the row-number strip (Qt::Vertical, sections packed along y): everything
axis dependent goes through the small helpers below, so the resize gesture, the
drag reorder with its preview, the transition and the pane packing are written
once.

Invariants (§19):
- only visible sections (+ overscan) and pinned sections own a widget, so the
widget count never grows with the number of columns,
- a pooled widget is unbound and keeps no identity,
- section geometry always comes from HeaderGeometry, which stays the single
source of truth for sizes, order, visibility and the horizontal offset,
- a section whose child has focus or an open popup is pinned, not recycled
(§36).

entries.comment:
Visual geometry animation (§23/§24), on by default.

A section move is the one interaction whose committed geometry is final
before the user sees the result, so the renderer slides the section from its
old position to the committed one instead of teleporting. In VirtualTableView,
body widgets follow these visual positions according to the table's column
and row following settings, both enabled by default. HeaderGeometry, scroll
bars and geometry queries continue to use the committed positions.

Resizing a section, scrolling and pane changes stay immediate: those are the
cases where the body follows every geometry change directly.

types.name: VirtualItemView
types.comment:
Virtualization kernel shared by the List/Table/Tree views.

The kernel owns the scroll space, the visible range computation, the
materialization and recycling of item widgets, the invalidation coalescing
and the selection/current handling. Subclasses only supply the identity
mapping (view row <-> QModelIndex) and a LayoutPolicy.

Invariants (see docs/history/architecture.md):
- materialized widgets == visible + overscan + pinned items,
- pooled widgets are unbound,
- one QModelIndex owns at most one widget at any time,
- model mutations never require a manual reload() from business code.

documentation.zh: scrollTo() 定位策略，最终位置受实际滚动范围约束。
documentation.en: scrollTo() positioning hint; final position is clamped to the available scroll range.
