defaults.en: 0; no auto-height limit; when enabled, height is calculated from all content.

examples.zh: 在垂直布局中按内容高度显示表格，最多 240 逻辑像素。view 为已设置 model 和 adapter 的 VirtualTableView；框架计算表头、内容和边框总高。不要再对同一控件调用 QWidget::setFixedHeight()。无内部滚动范围时滚轮会转交外层。
examples.en: Size a table to its content in a vertical layout, capped at 240 logical pixels. view is a VirtualTableView with a model and adapter. The framework includes header, content and border heights. Do not also call QWidget::setFixedHeight() on this view. Wheel events pass outward when there is no internal scroll range.

documentation.zh: 返回自适应高度独立上限；0 表示不限。
documentation.en: Return the independent auto-height limit; 0 means unlimited.

notes.zh: 虚拟视图默认关闭，WrapWidget 默认开启。启用后按内容设置固定高度，父布局不再把它压缩；上限为 0 时不限高。高度包含边距、间距、表头和实际边框等占位。使用 setAutoHeightMaximumHeight 控制上限，不要同时用 QWidget 高度约束干预；关闭后恢复原约束。内部无滚动范围时，滚轮交给外层。
notes.en: Disabled by default on virtual views and enabled on WrapWidget. When enabled, content sets a fixed height that the parent layout cannot compress; a maximum of 0 is unlimited. The height includes margins, gaps, headers and occupied frame space. Use setAutoHeightMaximumHeight rather than competing QWidget height constraints; disabling restores prior constraints. Wheel input propagates outward when there is no internal scroll range.

defaults.zh: 0；不限制自适应高度，启用后按全部内容计算。
defaults.en: 0; no auto-height limit; when enabled, height is calculated from all content.

entries.comment: Content-based preferred height while auto height is enabled.

documentation.zh: 返回布局或控件的建议尺寸或最小建议尺寸，供父布局协商；auto height 启用时由内容固定高度。
documentation.en: Return preferred or minimum size hints for parent layout negotiation; auto height fixes the actual height from content when enabled.

entries.comment: Preserves the computed content height in any parent layout.

documentation.zh: 返回布局或控件的建议尺寸或最小建议尺寸，供父布局协商；auto height 启用时由内容固定高度。
documentation.en: Return preferred or minimum size hints for parent layout negotiation; auto height fixes the actual height from content when enabled.

documentation.zh: 连接新的数据模型并更新布局、选择与物化状态；模型生命周期需覆盖视图使用期间。不要用重复 setModel 代替数据变更通知。
documentation.en: Connect a new data model and update layout, selection and materialization. Keep the model alive while in use; do not replace change notifications with repeated setModel calls.

defaults.en: nullptr; no model is attached initially.

documentation.zh: 返回项目数据模型。
documentation.en: Return the item data model.

defaults.en: nullptr; no model is attached initially.

entries.comment:
Replaces the selection model. The model of \a selectionModel has to be
model(); a selection model of another model is rejected with a warning,
because the view would otherwise hold two different models at once.

documentation.zh: 设置维护当前项和选中项的选择模型。
documentation.en: Set the selection model holding current and selected indexes.

defaults.zh: 初始 nullptr；设置模型时自动创建对应的 QItemSelectionModel。
defaults.en: Initially nullptr; attaching a model automatically creates the corresponding QItemSelectionModel.

documentation.zh: 返回维护当前项和选中项的选择模型。
documentation.en: Return the selection model holding current and selected indexes.

defaults.zh: 初始 nullptr；设置模型时自动创建对应的 QItemSelectionModel。
defaults.en: Initially nullptr; attaching a model automatically creates the corresponding QItemSelectionModel.

documentation.zh: 项的目标 hover/selection 状态与当前动画进度。布尔值描述目标，进度用于平滑绘制，动画期间可尚未到达目标。
documentation.en: Target hover/selection state and current animation progress. Booleans describe targets; progress drives smooth painting and may still be transitioning.

members.name: hovered
members.zh: hover 目标状态，默认 false。
members.en: Target hover state; defaults to false.

members.name: selected
members.zh: 选中目标状态，默认 false。
members.en: Target selected state; defaults to false.

members.name: hoverProgress
members.zh: hover 绘制进度 0～1，默认 0。
members.en: Hover progress in [0,1]; defaults to 0.

members.name: selectedProgress
members.zh: 选中绘制进度 0～1，默认 0。
members.en: Selection progress in [0,1]; defaults to 0.

entries.comment:
State of an index for business-widget painting. Hover and selection may
both be true; the business widget decides which appearance takes priority.

documentation.zh: 返回指定项目或 section 的当前视觉状态与动画进度。adapter 与背景绘制应使用同一份状态。
documentation.en: Return the current visual state and animation progress for an item or section. Adapters and background painting should use consistent state.

documentation.zh: 返回当前普通 hover 对应模型索引。
documentation.en: Return the current ordinary-hover model index.

entries.comment:
Colors available to business widgets that paint hover/selection backgrounds.
Changing either color notifies materialized widgets to repaint.

documentation.zh: 设置普通 hover 背景颜色。
documentation.en: Set the ordinary hover background color.

documentation.zh: 返回普通 hover 背景颜色。
documentation.en: Return the ordinary hover background color.

documentation.zh: 设置选中状态背景颜色。
documentation.en: Set the selected-state background color.

documentation.zh: 返回选中状态背景颜色。
documentation.en: Return the selected-state background color.

entries.comment: Duration of hover/selection color transitions (default 180 ms); zero disables animation.

documentation.zh: 设置hover 和选中动画时长（毫秒）。
documentation.en: Set the hover and selection animation duration in milliseconds.

notes.zh: 默认时长 180ms，曲线 OutCubic。adapter 应使用 visualState 中的进度，以保持子控件与框架背景同步。原生拖动期间普通 hover 暂停并清空，结束后按当前鼠标位置恢复。
notes.en: Defaults to 180 ms with OutCubic easing. Adapters should use visualState progress to stay synchronized with framework backgrounds. Native dragging suspends and clears ordinary hover, restoring it at the current cursor position afterward.

documentation.zh: 返回hover 和选中动画时长（毫秒）。
documentation.en: Return the hover and selection animation duration in milliseconds.

notes.zh: 默认时长 180ms，曲线 OutCubic。adapter 应使用 visualState 中的进度，以保持子控件与框架背景同步。原生拖动期间普通 hover 暂停并清空，结束后按当前鼠标位置恢复。
notes.en: Defaults to 180 ms with OutCubic easing. Adapters should use visualState progress to stay synchronized with framework backgrounds. Native dragging suspends and clears ordinary hover, restoring it at the current cursor position afterward.

entries.comment:
Curve shared by hover/selection transitions (default OutCubic).
Changing it resets the current transitions, like changing their duration.

documentation.zh: 设置hover 和选中缓动曲线。
documentation.en: Set the hover and selection easing curve.

notes.zh: 默认时长 180ms，曲线 OutCubic。adapter 应使用 visualState 中的进度，以保持子控件与框架背景同步。原生拖动期间普通 hover 暂停并清空，结束后按当前鼠标位置恢复。
notes.en: Defaults to 180 ms with OutCubic easing. Adapters should use visualState progress to stay synchronized with framework backgrounds. Native dragging suspends and clears ordinary hover, restoring it at the current cursor position afterward.

documentation.zh: 返回hover 和选中缓动曲线。
documentation.en: Return the hover and selection easing curve.

notes.zh: 默认时长 180ms，曲线 OutCubic。adapter 应使用 visualState 中的进度，以保持子控件与框架背景同步。原生拖动期间普通 hover 暂停并清空，结束后按当前鼠标位置恢复。
notes.en: Defaults to 180 ms with OutCubic easing. Adapters should use visualState progress to stay synchronized with framework backgrounds. Native dragging suspends and clears ordinary hover, restoring it at the current cursor position afterward.

documentation.zh: 返回当前项索引（区别于所有选中项）。
documentation.en: Return the current index, distinct from the full selection.

defaults.zh: 无效 QModelIndex；初始没有 current 项，此接口修改当前项而非配置常量。
defaults.en: Invalid QModelIndex; there is initially no current item. This updates current state rather than a configuration constant.

documentation.zh: 设置当前项索引（区别于所有选中项）。
documentation.en: Set the current index, distinct from the full selection.

defaults.zh: 无效 QModelIndex；初始没有 current 项，此接口修改当前项而非配置常量。
defaults.en: Invalid QModelIndex; there is initially no current item. This updates current state rather than a configuration constant.

entries.comment:
Makes \a index current and reports the same signals as a click
(clicked()/activated()). §37: a screen reader "presses" an item, and
business code reacts through the signals it already handles.

documentation.zh: 激活指定索引，走视图的项目激活流程。
documentation.en: Activate the specified index through the view item activation path.

entries.comment: How selection gestures are interpreted (mirrors QAbstractItemView).

documentation.zh: 用户选择手势模式，不限制 selectionModel() 的显式批量选择；选择单元由 SelectionBehavior 决定。
documentation.en: User selection gestures, not a restriction on explicit batch selection through selectionModel(). SelectionBehavior defines the unit.

members.name: NoSelection
members.zh: 用户手势不改变选择。
members.en: User gestures do not change selection.

members.name: SingleSelection
members.zh: 用户交互只保留一个选择项。
members.en: User interaction keeps one selected item.

members.name: MultiSelection
members.zh: 单击切换选中，允许多项。
members.en: Clicks toggle selection, allowing multiple items.

members.name: ExtendedSelection
members.zh: 普通点击、Ctrl 切换、Shift 范围选择；默认模式。
members.en: Ordinary clicks, Ctrl toggles and Shift ranges; the default.

entries.comment:
Which part of an item gets selected: the item, or its whole row. There is
deliberately no SelectColumns: table header selection is configured separately
from body gestures through VirtualTableView.

documentation.zh: 选择和内置 hover/selection 绘制范围。表格支持按格和按行。
documentation.en: Selection unit and built-in hover/selection extent. Tables support cells and rows.

members.name: SelectItems
members.zh: 表格按单元格选择和绘制状态。
members.en: Select and paint state per table cell.

members.name: SelectRows
members.zh: 整行选择和绘制状态，默认值。
members.en: Select and paint state across the row; the default.

documentation.zh: 设置单选、多选、扩展或禁止用户选择模式。
documentation.en: Set the single, multiple, extended or no-user-selection mode.

notes.zh: 默认 ExtendedSelection + SelectRows。SelectRows 同时让 hover/selected 按行显示；SelectItems 按 cell 显示。SelectionMode 约束用户手势；程序批量选择使用 selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags)，不要循环 setCurrentIndex。
notes.en: Defaults to ExtendedSelection + SelectRows. SelectRows highlights hover/selection by row; SelectItems highlights cells. SelectionMode constrains user gestures. For programmatic ranges use selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags), not repeated setCurrentIndex calls.

examples.zh: 按单元格选择，并仅在内容区域绘制状态背景。view 为 VirtualTableView；ExtendedSelection 支持 Ctrl/Shift，SelectItems 同时决定 hover/selection 的单元格范围。关闭表头状态同步不影响内容选择。
examples.en: Select cells and paint state backgrounds only in the body. view is a VirtualTableView. ExtendedSelection supports Ctrl/Shift, while SelectItems sets the cell extent for both hover and selection. Disabling header state painting does not disable body selection.

documentation.zh: 返回单选、多选、扩展或禁止用户选择模式。
documentation.en: Return the single, multiple, extended or no-user-selection mode.

notes.zh: 默认 ExtendedSelection + SelectRows。SelectRows 同时让 hover/selected 按行显示；SelectItems 按 cell 显示。SelectionMode 约束用户手势；程序批量选择使用 selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags)，不要循环 setCurrentIndex。
notes.en: Defaults to ExtendedSelection + SelectRows. SelectRows highlights hover/selection by row; SelectItems highlights cells. SelectionMode constrains user gestures. For programmatic ranges use selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags), not repeated setCurrentIndex calls.

entries.comment:
Whole rows are selected by default. Tables use the same row/cell choice
for hover and selected visual states.

documentation.zh: 设置按行或单元格选择行为。
documentation.en: Set the row or cell selection behavior.

notes.zh: 默认 ExtendedSelection + SelectRows。SelectRows 同时让 hover/selected 按行显示；SelectItems 按 cell 显示。SelectionMode 约束用户手势；程序批量选择使用 selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags)，不要循环 setCurrentIndex。
notes.en: Defaults to ExtendedSelection + SelectRows. SelectRows highlights hover/selection by row; SelectItems highlights cells. SelectionMode constrains user gestures. For programmatic ranges use selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags), not repeated setCurrentIndex calls.

examples.zh: 按单元格选择，并仅在内容区域绘制状态背景。view 为 VirtualTableView；ExtendedSelection 支持 Ctrl/Shift，SelectItems 同时决定 hover/selection 的单元格范围。关闭表头状态同步不影响内容选择。
examples.en: Select cells and paint state backgrounds only in the body. view is a VirtualTableView. ExtendedSelection supports Ctrl/Shift, while SelectItems sets the cell extent for both hover and selection. Disabling header state painting does not disable body selection.

documentation.zh: 返回按行或单元格选择行为。
documentation.en: Return the row or cell selection behavior.

notes.zh: 默认 ExtendedSelection + SelectRows。SelectRows 同时让 hover/selected 按行显示；SelectItems 按 cell 显示。SelectionMode 约束用户手势；程序批量选择使用 selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags)，不要循环 setCurrentIndex。
notes.en: Defaults to ExtendedSelection + SelectRows. SelectRows highlights hover/selection by row; SelectItems highlights cells. SelectionMode constrains user gestures. For programmatic ranges use selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags), not repeated setCurrentIndex calls.

entries.comment:
Where a drop lands: the insertion row inside \a parent. Dropping *onto* an
item is expressed as (item, item.rowCount()) - the same convention
QAbstractItemModel::dropMimeData() uses - and is flagged through
\a ontoItem so the view paints a frame instead of an insertion line.
A table may instead target an existing cell: parent is that cell,
row and column are -1, and both ontoItem and cellDrop are true.
Otherwise \a column is -1 unless the view resolves a cell (tables).

documentation.zh: 拖放命中结果。插入 row/column 是 parent 下的模型坐标，不是展开后的可见行号；ontoItem 表示放入项内。有效位置仍需通过模型 canDropMimeData()/dropMimeData() 的限制。
documentation.en: Resolved drop target. Insertion row/column are model coordinates under parent, not flattened visible row numbers. ontoItem means dropping into an item. Valid locations still require model canDropMimeData()/dropMimeData() approval.

members.name: parent
members.zh: 插入父索引；ontoItem 时表示目标项。默认无效，插入时通常代表根层级。
members.en: Insertion parent, or destination item for ontoItem. Initially invalid, normally meaning root-level insertion.

members.name: row
members.zh: 父项下的插入行，默认 -1；单元格内部放置可为 -1。
members.en: Insertion row under parent; initially -1; cell drops may use -1.

members.name: column
members.zh: 模型列位置，默认 -1，需结合 row、cellDrop、ontoItem 解释。
members.en: Model column position; initially -1; interpret with row, cellDrop and ontoItem.

members.name: ontoItem
members.zh: 放到 parent 表示的节点／单元格内而非行间，默认 false。
members.en: Drop into the node/cell represented by parent rather than between rows; defaults to false.

members.name: trailing
members.zh: 命中末项下方空白；指示器标记内容尾部，row 为父项末尾插入位置，默认 false。
members.en: Hit space below the last item; indicator marks content end and row is insertion after the parent's last child; defaults to false.

members.name: cellDrop
members.zh: 载荷为单元格而非整行，默认 false；相邻插入不一定移除源行。
members.en: Cell payload rather than a whole row; defaults to false; adjacent insertion need not remove the source row.

members.name: isValid
members.zh: row≥0，或 cellDrop、ontoItem 均为 true、parent 有效且 row/column 均为 -1 时有效。只检查位置，不检查模型权限。
members.en: True for row>=0, or cellDrop and ontoItem with valid parent and row/column both -1. Checks location, not model permission.

entries.comment:
How the drop indicator is painted (§38). A subclass chooses by filling
DropTarget::ontoItem; an unknown target still gets the insertion line.

documentation.zh: 拖放指示器形状，与 DragFeedbackMode 不同；命中位置也决定使用插入线还是目标框。
documentation.en: Drop-indicator shape, distinct from DragFeedbackMode; resolved locations also determine insertion lines versus target frames.

members.name: Line
members.zh: 项之间的插入线，使用配置线宽和颜色。
members.en: Insertion line using configured width and color.

members.name: Frame
members.zh: 接收放置项的描边框。
members.en: Outline around the receiving item.

entries.comment:
Enables starting a drag from an item whose flags contain
Qt::ItemIsDragEnabled. The drag carries model->mimeData() and, while it is
active, the dragged item's widget is pinned so the recycler cannot take it
away from the drag (§36/§38). The same switch makes the view a drop
target: the model stays the authority (canDropMimeData()/dropMimeData())
and the item flags decide what may be dragged or dropped onto.

documentation.zh: 设置项目拖动开关。
documentation.en: Set the item dragging setting.

examples.zh: 为表格启用自动起拖和虚线插入指示器。view 为 VirtualTableView；模型必须提供拖放 flags、MIME 与移动/放下实现。这里不启用 setMoveRemovesSourceRows：若 dropMimeData() 自己移动原项，再删除源行会重复移除。
examples.en: Enable automatic table dragging with a dashed insertion indicator. view is a VirtualTableView; its model must implement drag/drop flags, MIME and move/drop behavior. setMoveRemovesSourceRows is intentionally left disabled: if dropMimeData() already moves the originals, removing source rows again would delete them twice.

documentation.zh: 返回项目拖动开关。
documentation.en: Return the item dragging setting.

entries.comment:
Automatic starts after the mouse crosses the drag distance; Manual leaves
initiation to startDrag(). Neither mode changes model/drop permissions.

documentation.zh: 起拖入口；均需模型支持相应 flags、MIME 和 drop 行为。
documentation.en: Drag-start strategy; both require corresponding model flags, MIME and drop behavior.

members.name: Automatic
members.zh: 按下并移动超过拖动阈值后由视图起拖。
members.en: The view starts dragging after movement exceeds the press threshold.

members.name: Manual
members.zh: 业务按钮或处理器显式调用 startDrag()。
members.en: Business buttons/handlers explicitly call startDrag().

documentation.zh: 设置自动或手动起拖模式。
documentation.en: Set the automatic or manual drag-start mode.

examples.zh: 为表格启用自动起拖和虚线插入指示器。view 为 VirtualTableView；模型必须提供拖放 flags、MIME 与移动/放下实现。这里不启用 setMoveRemovesSourceRows：若 dropMimeData() 自己移动原项，再删除源行会重复移除。
examples.en: Enable automatic table dragging with a dashed insertion indicator. view is a VirtualTableView; its model must implement drag/drop flags, MIME and move/drop behavior. setMoveRemovesSourceRows is intentionally left disabled: if dropMimeData() already moves the originals, removing source rows again would delete them twice.

documentation.zh: 返回自动或手动起拖模式。
documentation.en: Return the automatic or manual drag-start mode.

entries.comment: True when \a index would start a drag right now.

documentation.zh: 检查给定索引是否满足当前拖动条件；可在显示拖动手柄或发起操作前查询。
documentation.en: Check whether the index meets current drag-start requirements, for example before enabling a drag handle.

entries.comment:
Starts a drag for the current selection (or \a index). Returns the action
the drop target reported; Qt::IgnoreAction when nothing was dragged.
The preview is anchored at the matching mouse press, or the current cursor.

documentation.zh: 显式启动原生拖动；框架管理预览、普通 hover 暂停及结束恢复。行选择预览整行，单元格选择预览目标 cell；模型负责 MIME 和落点合法性。
documentation.en: Start a native drag explicitly. The framework manages preview, ordinary hover suspension and restoration. Row selection previews a row; cell selection previews a cell. The model controls MIME data and drop legality.

notes.zh: 此重载使用当前选择或 index 生成默认预览；预览锚定匹配的鼠标按下位置，没有匹配事件时使用当前鼠标位置。 返回实际 Qt::DropAction；未拖动、取消或无效落点返回 IgnoreAction。
notes.en: This overload generates the default preview from the current selection or index, anchored at the matching mouse press or the current cursor when no press matches. Returns the actual Qt::DropAction, or IgnoreAction when no drag completes.

entries.comment:
Starts with optional preview overrides; no widget/rectangle uses the default view preview.
An explicit widget with an empty rectangle is captured whole; pinning and MIME use the source index.

documentation.zh: 显式启动原生拖动；框架管理预览、普通 hover 暂停及结束恢复。行选择预览整行，单元格选择预览目标 cell；模型负责 MIME 和落点合法性。
documentation.en: Start a native drag explicitly. The framework manages preview, ordinary hover suspension and restoration. Row selection previews a row; cell selection previews a cell. The model controls MIME data and drop legality.

notes.zh: 此重载用 DragOptions 覆盖截图控件或截图区域。显式控件配空矩形时截取整个控件；源索引仍用于 MIME 数据和屏外保留。 返回实际 Qt::DropAction；未拖动、取消或无效落点返回 IgnoreAction。
notes.en: This overload uses DragOptions to override the captured widget or rectangle. An explicit widget with an empty rectangle captures the entire widget; the source index still controls MIME data and pinning. Returns the actual Qt::DropAction, or IgnoreAction when no drag completes.

entries.comment:
Draws the drop indicator (a line between rows, or a frame around the item
a tree would drop into).

documentation.zh: 设置拖放指示器可见性。
documentation.en: Set the drop indicator visibility.

documentation.zh: 返回拖放指示器可见性。
documentation.en: Return the drop indicator visibility.

entries.comment:
Color shared by insertion lines and target frames. An invalid color
(the default) follows QPalette::Highlight; the getter returns that setting.

documentation.zh: 设置拖放指示器颜色。
documentation.en: Set the drop indicator color.

documentation.zh: 返回拖放指示器颜色。
documentation.en: Return the drop indicator color.

entries.comment:
Stroke width in logical pixels (default 2). Negative values become zero;
zero hides the indicator without changing drop permissions.

documentation.zh: 设置拖放指示器线宽。
documentation.en: Set the drop indicator width.

documentation.zh: 返回拖放指示器线宽。
documentation.en: Return the drop indicator width.

entries.comment:
Built-in pen style shared by lines and frames (default SolidLine).
NoPen hides the indicator; unsupported/custom styles use SolidLine.

documentation.zh: 设置拖放指示器线型。
documentation.en: Set the drop indicator pen style.

examples.zh: 为表格启用自动起拖和虚线插入指示器。view 为 VirtualTableView；模型必须提供拖放 flags、MIME 与移动/放下实现。这里不启用 setMoveRemovesSourceRows：若 dropMimeData() 自己移动原项，再删除源行会重复移除。
examples.en: Enable automatic table dragging with a dashed insertion indicator. view is a VirtualTableView; its model must implement drag/drop flags, MIME and move/drop behavior. setMoveRemovesSourceRows is intentionally left disabled: if dropMimeData() already moves the originals, removing source rows again would delete them twice.

documentation.zh: 返回拖放指示器线型。
documentation.en: Return the drop indicator pen style.

entries.comment: Action used for drags started by this view (CopyAction by default).

documentation.zh: 设置默认拖放动作。
documentation.en: Set the default drop action.

examples.zh: 为表格启用自动起拖和虚线插入指示器。view 为 VirtualTableView；模型必须提供拖放 flags、MIME 与移动/放下实现。这里不启用 setMoveRemovesSourceRows：若 dropMimeData() 自己移动原项，再删除源行会重复移除。
examples.en: Enable automatic table dragging with a dashed insertion indicator. view is a VirtualTableView; its model must implement drag/drop flags, MIME and move/drop behavior. setMoveRemovesSourceRows is intentionally left disabled: if dropMimeData() already moves the originals, removing source rows again would delete them twice.

documentation.zh: 返回默认拖放动作。
documentation.en: Return the default drop action.

entries.comment:
Whether a drag that ends in `Qt::MoveAction` removes the rows this view dragged.

Off by default: the library's contract is "the model owns the semantics" (§38), so a model
that implements the move itself (remove + insert, like the example's list model) already
produces a move. A *cross-view* move cannot be expressed that way - the source model never
learns that a foreign view accepted the drop - and Qt's own item views solve it in the
view (`QAbstractItemView` removes the dragged rows after a successful move drop). Turn this
on for that Qt behaviour: the view then removes its dragged rows whenever the drag ends as
a move, skipping any row the model has already removed (so a model that moves by
remove + insert is not touched twice). A model that implements a move while *keeping* the
row identities (e.g. `moveRows()`) must keep this off - it would look like an untouched,
still-present source row and be removed a second time.
For row-insertion drops between these views, selected source cells transfer
to their inserted counterparts after source deletion. This requires sibling
source rows inserted in order as one block; ambiguous drops are left to the model.

documentation.zh: 设置成功移动后框架删除源行开关。
documentation.en: Set the framework source row removal after a successful move.

notes.zh: 用于模型 dropMimeData 插入副本但未自行删除源行的 MoveAction。若模型已通过 moveRows 或 dropMimeData 完成移动，不应重复启用源行删除。框架删除源行时会尝试继承源项选择状态。
notes.en: Use for MoveAction when dropMimeData inserts a copy without removing source rows. Do not duplicate source removal if the model already moves rows in moveRows or dropMimeData. Framework-managed removal attempts to preserve source selection.

documentation.zh: 返回成功移动后框架删除源行开关。
documentation.en: Return the framework source row removal after a successful move.

notes.zh: 用于模型 dropMimeData 插入副本但未自行删除源行的 MoveAction。若模型已通过 moveRows 或 dropMimeData 完成移动，不应重复启用源行删除。框架删除源行时会尝试继承源项选择状态。
notes.en: Use for MoveAction when dropMimeData inserts a copy without removing source rows. Do not duplicate source removal if the model already moves rows in moveRows or dropMimeData. Framework-managed removal attempts to preserve source selection.

entries.signature: virtual void setAdapter(WidgetAdapter *adapter, bool takeOwnership = false);
entries.comment:
Installs the widget adapter. **Virtual on purpose**: a subclass whose materialization
is typed (`VirtualTableView`) has to keep its own adapter in sync with this one, and a
call through a `VirtualItemView *` must reach that override - otherwise the base
pointer and the subclass pointer could name two different adapters, and one adapter
would bind the QWidgets the other created (P1 of the fourth review).

documentation.zh: 设置项目控件适配器。
documentation.en: Set the item widget adapter.

notes.zh: takeOwnership 默认为 false，未转移所有权时调用方须保证 adapter 存活。RowWidgets 使用 TableWidgetAdapter，CellWidgets 使用 CellWidgetAdapter。创建控件和绑定数据应分离；复用时清除旧业务关联。
notes.en: takeOwnership defaults to false; the caller must keep a non-owned adapter alive. RowWidgets uses TableWidgetAdapter and CellWidgets uses CellWidgetAdapter. Separate widget creation from binding and clear obsolete business associations on reuse.

defaults.zh: nullptr；初始没有业务 adapter。takeOwnership 参数默认 false。
defaults.en: nullptr; no application adapter is installed. The takeOwnership argument defaults to false.

documentation.zh: 返回项目控件适配器。
documentation.en: Return the item widget adapter.

notes.zh: takeOwnership 默认为 false，未转移所有权时调用方须保证 adapter 存活。RowWidgets 使用 TableWidgetAdapter，CellWidgets 使用 CellWidgetAdapter。创建控件和绑定数据应分离；复用时清除旧业务关联。
notes.en: takeOwnership defaults to false; the caller must keep a non-owned adapter alive. RowWidgets uses TableWidgetAdapter and CellWidgets uses CellWidgetAdapter. Separate widget creation from binding and clear obsolete business associations on reuse.

defaults.zh: nullptr；初始没有业务 adapter。takeOwnership 参数默认 false。
defaults.en: nullptr; no application adapter is installed. The takeOwnership argument defaults to false.

documentation.en: Return the widget recycler used by the view.

entries.comment:
Default gestures, initially DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed (F2).
An adapter can override them per index; child controls use edit(index).

documentation.zh: 设置进入编辑的交互触发条件。
documentation.en: Set the interaction triggers that start editing.

notes.zh: 视图默认 DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed（F2）。adapter 可按 index 覆盖；按钮或外部操作直接调用 view->edit(index)。模型需设置 ItemIsEditable 和 ItemIsEnabled。
notes.en: The view defaults to DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed (F2). Adapters can override per index. Buttons and external actions call view->edit(index). The model item must have ItemIsEditable and ItemIsEnabled.

examples.zh: view 已绑定支持 createEditor() 的 adapter，index 是其模型的有效索引，且 flags 包含 ItemIsEnabled / ItemIsEditable。自动手势与显式 edit() 相互独立；行内按钮处理器中同样调用 edit(index)。
examples.en: view has an adapter implementing createEditor(); index is valid in its model and has ItemIsEnabled / ItemIsEditable flags. Automatic gestures and explicit edit() are independent; an inline button handler can also call edit(index).

documentation.zh: 返回进入编辑的交互触发条件。
documentation.en: Return the interaction triggers that start editing.

notes.zh: 视图默认 DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed（F2）。adapter 可按 index 覆盖；按钮或外部操作直接调用 view->edit(index)。模型需设置 ItemIsEditable 和 ItemIsEnabled。
notes.en: The view defaults to DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed (F2). Adapters can override per index. Buttons and external actions call view->edit(index). The model item must have ItemIsEditable and ItemIsEnabled.

entries.comment:
Requests editing for an enabled, editable index, independently of automatic
triggers. Commits the previous overlay editor or cancels the previous
adapter-owned request, then calls editRequest().
True means the adapter handled the request or an overlay editor was opened.

documentation.zh: 请求编辑指定索引，独立于自动触发配置。模型必须允许编辑且启用项目；先走 adapter.editRequest，再创建覆盖编辑器。
documentation.en: Request editing for the index independently of automatic triggers. The model item must be enabled and editable. adapter.editRequest runs before overlay creation.

examples.zh: view 已绑定支持 createEditor() 的 adapter，index 是其模型的有效索引，且 flags 包含 ItemIsEnabled / ItemIsEditable。自动手势与显式 edit() 相互独立；行内按钮处理器中同样调用 edit(index)。
examples.en: view has an adapter implementing createEditor(); index is valid in its model and has ItemIsEnabled / ItemIsEditable flags. Automatic gestures and explicit edit() are independent; an inline button handler can also call edit(index).

entries.comment:
Commits and closes an overlay editor. False keeps a rejected editor open;
also returns false for adapter-owned requests, whose popup owns submission.

documentation.zh: 提交当前覆盖编辑器内容；提交失败时保留编辑器。
documentation.en: Commit the active overlay editor, keeping it open if committing fails.

notes.zh: 成功时提交并关闭覆盖编辑器；adapter 接管的 Popup 由业务提交，本函数返回 false。
notes.en: Success commits and closes the overlay. Adapter-owned Popups handle their own submission; this method returns false for them.

entries.comment:
Cancels without writing the draft, including adapter-owned requests via
cancelEditRequest().

documentation.zh: 取消当前编辑，不提交草稿；也会通过 cancelEditRequest 取消适配器接管的 Popup。
documentation.en: Cancel the current edit without committing the draft, including adapter-owned Popups through cancelEditRequest.

entries.comment:
Currently edited index/widget, or an invalid index/null when not editing.
Adapter-owned requests expose their index, but editorWidget() is null.

documentation.zh: 返回当前编辑会话对应索引；无会话时返回无效索引。
documentation.en: Return the active edit session index, or an invalid index when no session exists.

documentation.zh: 返回当前覆盖编辑器；没有覆盖编辑器或由 Popup 接管时可能为空。
documentation.en: Return the active overlay editor; it may be null when no overlay exists or a Popup owns editing.

entries.comment:
Model role containing one complete business payload for a row or tree node.
Cell widgets read this role from their row's canonical column (column 0).
Changing it rebinds materialized items. A negative role disables payload reads.

documentation.en: Set the model role read into binding context rowData.

notes.zh: cell 从所在行的列 0 读取该 role。负数禁用 rowData 读取；修改 role 会重新绑定已物化控件。

documentation.en: Return the model role read into binding context rowData.

entries.comment: Number of extra items materialized before/after the visible range.

examples.zh: 设置间距中心分割线，并在水平表头下添加完整行间距。view 为 VirtualTableView；Horizontal 对应表头下方，Vertical 对应行号条右侧。这里额外表头间距为 rowSpacing() 的 8 像素，不是独立数值。

documentation.zh: 返回行间距。
documentation.en: Return the spacing between rows.

entries.comment:
Grid lines use the gap center by default, or both gap edges when requested.
With zero spacing both modes use a single shared item boundary.

documentation.zh: 设置间距中心或两侧分割线模式。
documentation.en: Set the grid line placement at spacing centers or edges.

notes.zh: 默认 SpacingCenter：在间距中心绘制，交叉线始终穿过间距，且外侧补半间距；零间距时不重复画线。SpacingEdges 在间距两侧绘制，只有这个模式允许控制是否穿过交叉间距。是否穿过表头使用单独开关。
notes.en: SpacingCenter is the default: lines run through gap centers, cross gaps unconditionally, and use outer half-gaps; zero spacing does not duplicate lines. SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

defaults.zh: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter；无间距时回退到项边界，不重复绘制。
defaults.en: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter; without spacing, lines fall back to item boundaries without duplicates.

SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

entries.comment:
Automatically hides the terminal row grid line for auto height or vertical
overflow (default true). False keeps it whenever row grid lines are enabled.
Shared by list, tree, table, tree-table and flow views, including default row headers.

documentation.zh: 设置贴近底边框自动隐藏末行线开关。
documentation.en: Set the automatic trailing row line hiding next to the bottom frame.

notes.zh: 默认自动隐藏，避免末行线贴合底边框叠成双线。关闭后始终按分割线规则绘制末行边界；边距、实际内容底部及滚动范围仍决定其可见位置。
notes.en: Automatic hiding is enabled by default to avoid doubling a line next to the bottom frame. Disable it to retain the trailing boundary according to grid rules; margins, the actual content bottom and scroll range still determine visibility.

examples.zh: 在垂直布局中按内容高度显示表格，最多 240 逻辑像素。view 为已设置 model 和 adapter 的 VirtualTableView；框架计算表头、内容和边框总高。不要再对同一控件调用 QWidget::setFixedHeight()。无内部滚动范围时滚轮会转交外层。
examples.en: Size a table to its content in a vertical layout, capped at 240 logical pixels. view is a VirtualTableView with a model and adapter. The framework includes header, content and border heights. Do not also call QWidget::setFixedHeight() on this view. Wheel events pass outward when there is no internal scroll range.

documentation.zh: 返回贴近底边框自动隐藏末行线开关。
documentation.en: Return the automatic trailing row line hiding next to the bottom frame.

notes.zh: 默认自动隐藏，避免末行线贴合底边框叠成双线。关闭后始终按分割线规则绘制末行边界；边距、实际内容底部及滚动范围仍决定其可见位置。

entries.signature: void setItemPinned(const QModelIndex &index, bool pinned = true);
entries.comment:
Keeps the widget of \a index materialized even when it leaves the
overscan window, and materializes it right away when it is not on screen
at all (business code can request a pin for async operations). Each pin
costs one widget until it is unpinned - see setMaxPinnedItems().

documentation.zh: 保留或解除保留屏外项目控件；尚未物化的项目会立即物化。maxPinnedItems 是诊断软上限，不会自动回收已保留控件，业务需要主动解除保留。
documentation.en: Pin or unpin an offscreen item widget, materializing it immediately if needed. maxPinnedItems is a diagnostic soft limit and never automatically recycles pinned widgets; the application must unpin them.

defaults.en: false; no items are explicitly pinned.

entries.comment: Includes the temporary pin held by an active drag; explicit pins are independent.

documentation.zh: 返回指定项目屏外保留状态。
documentation.en: Return the offscreen pinning state of the specified item.

notes.zh: 包括原生拖动期间的临时保留；显式保留独立于该临时状态。
notes.en: Includes temporary pinning during native dragging; explicit pins are independent of that temporary state.

entries.comment:
Pin/unpin the item that currently owns \a widget. Equivalent to

documentation.zh: 保留或解除保留屏外项目控件；尚未物化的项目会立即物化。maxPinnedItems 是诊断软上限，不会自动回收已保留控件，业务需要主动解除保留。
documentation.en: Pin or unpin an offscreen item widget, materializing it immediately if needed. maxPinnedItems is a diagnostic soft limit and never automatically recycles pinned widgets; the application must unpin them.

documentation.en: Pin or unpin an offscreen item widget, materializing it immediately if needed. maxPinnedItems is a diagnostic soft limit and never automatically recycles pinned widgets; the application must unpin them.

Soft cap for pinned items; exceeding it logs a qWarning once. Pinned
items are never recycled automatically, so this is a debugging aid for
"business code pins too much". A value <= 0 disables the check.

documentation.zh: 设置屏外保留项目数的诊断软上限；超出仅警告一次，不会强制回收。非正值关闭检查。
documentation.en: Set the diagnostic soft limit for pinned items. Exceeding it warns once without forcibly recycling widgets; nonpositive values disable the check.

defaults.en: 0; no limit on explicitly pinned items.

documentation.zh: 返回屏外保留项目数的诊断软上限；超出仅警告一次，不会强制回收。非正值关闭检查。

Opt-in timing of synchronous refresh work, callbacks and framework painting.
Filter qCDebug output with viv.performance.refresh and viv.performance.paint.
Active work is aggregated per view/category and logged once per second.
Summaries show hot stages; viv.performance.details enables the full timing table.

entries.comment:
Wheel scrolling granularity.

entries.comment: How item sizes (row heights) are determined.

documentation.en: Kernel row-layout height strategy; Flow, Masonry and Wrap use dedicated sizing APIs.

members.zh: 所有项统一高度。
members.en: All items share one height.

members.zh: 不同项可有不同高度，配合估算、显式高度和测量。

documentation.zh: 返回统一或可变高度策略。

defaults.zh: ItemHeightMode::Uniform；Flow / Masonry / Wrap 使用各自布局接口，不支持此继承设置。
defaults.en: ItemHeightMode::Uniform; Flow / Masonry / Wrap use their own layout APIs and do not support this inherited setting.

entries.comment:
Fixed height of every item. Passing 0 enables "fit to the first
materialized item" (requires setAutoMeasureItemHeight(true)).

documentation.zh: 设置统一高度模式行高。
documentation.en: Set the row height in uniform-height mode.

notes.zh: 统一高度设为 0 且开启自动测量时，使用首个物化项确定高度。Flow/Masonry/Wrap 使用专用尺寸 API，不支持套用内核自动行高测量。

documentation.zh: 返回统一高度模式行高。

entries.comment: Height used for items that were never measured in Variable mode.

documentation.zh: 返回未测量项目估计高度。
documentation.en: Return the estimated height of unmeasured items.

entries.comment:
Enables measuring the size hint of bound widgets (Variable mode) and the
first-item fitting of Uniform mode. Enabled by default, except in
VirtualFlowTableView and VirtualMasonryView, which disable measurement and
reject attempts to enable it; use their dedicated height APIs instead.

documentation.zh: 设置物化后自动测量高度的开关。

defaults.zh: true；Flow / Masonry / Wrap 构造时关闭且不支持开启，使用各自布局接口。

notes.en: Uniform height 0 with automatic measurement uses the first materialized item to determine height. Flow/Masonry/Wrap use dedicated size APIs rather than kernel automatic row measurement.

entries.comment: Visible item range without overscan.

documentation.zh: 返回当前视口及布局计算出的可见项目范围。
documentation.en: Return the visible item ranges resolved by the viewport and layout.

entries.comment:
Freezes the first \a count rows at the top edge: they stay visible while the
rows below scroll, and they add no scroll space of their own (the frozen
height is not part of the scroll range, exactly like frozen columns).
Supported by list/table views; tree, flow and masonry views reject freezing.

The value is clamped to the row count, and a frozen row that cannot fit into
the viewport is not frozen at all: a frozen pane never shows a row that
sticks out of it.

documentation.zh: 设置顶部冻结行数。
documentation.en: Set the number of top frozen rows.

defaults.zh: 0；无冻结行，仅支持行 pane 的视图适用。Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap 不支持。
defaults.en: 0; no frozen rows; only views supporting row panes apply. Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap do not support them.

entries.comment: Frozen rows at the top edge (the effective, clamped count).

documentation.zh: 返回顶部冻结行数。

defaults.zh: 0；无冻结行，仅支持行 pane 的视图适用。Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap 不支持。
defaults.en: 0; no frozen rows; only views supporting row panes apply. Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap do not support them.

entries.comment:
Freezes the last \a count rows at the bottom edge. A row in both sets stays
on the top.

documentation.zh: 设置底部冻结行数。

defaults.zh: 0；无冻结行，仅支持行 pane 的视图适用。Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap 不支持。
defaults.en: 0; no frozen rows; only views supporting row panes apply. Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap do not support them.

entries.comment: Frozen rows at the bottom edge (the effective, clamped count).

documentation.zh: 返回底部冻结行数。
documentation.en: Return the number of bottom frozen rows.

defaults.zh: 0；无冻结行，仅支持行 pane 的视图适用。Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap 不支持。
defaults.en: 0; no frozen rows; only views supporting row panes apply. Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap do not support them.

documentation.zh: 判断当前窗格或指定行列是否固定在冻结区域。
documentation.en: Check whether the pane or specified row/column belongs to a frozen region.

entries.comment:
Visible panes, top to bottom: the frozen top pane (when it has rows), the
scrolling pane and the frozen bottom pane. Without frozen rows there is
exactly one scrolling pane covering the viewport.

documentation.zh: 返回当前行窗格集合。
documentation.en: Return the current row pane collection.

entries.comment: Pane rect in viewport coordinates (empty when the pane does not exist).

documentation.zh: 查询对应项目、单元格、窗格或合并区域的矩形。视图结果为视口坐标；布局策略结果为布局坐标；屏外矩形可超出可见区域。
documentation.en: Query the item, cell, pane or span rectangle. View results use viewport coordinates; layout policies use layout coordinates. Offscreen rectangles may extend beyond the visible area.

entries.comment:
Visible rows as up to three ranges: frozen top, scrolling window, frozen
bottom. Frozen rows are visible and their union with the window is not
contiguous, which is why visibleItemRange() keeps describing the scrolling
window only.

documentation.zh: 返回当前视口及布局计算出的可见项目范围。
documentation.en: Return the visible item ranges resolved by the viewport and layout.

entries.comment: Look of the line that separates the row panes.

documentation.zh: 设置冻结行窗格分隔线样式。
documentation.en: Set the row pane separator style.

defaults.zh: width = 1，color 无效（视图默认分隔色），lineStyle = Qt::SolidLine。
defaults.en: width = 1, invalid color (view default separator color), lineStyle = Qt::SolidLine.

documentation.zh: 返回冻结行窗格分隔线样式。
documentation.en: Return the row pane separator style.

defaults.zh: width = 1，color 无效（视图默认分隔色），lineStyle = Qt::SolidLine。
defaults.en: width = 1, invalid color (view default separator color), lineStyle = Qt::SolidLine.

entries.comment:
How far the row pane boundary lines reach to the *left* of the viewport, in
pixels. A table whose row-number strip lives outside the viewport returns its
width here, so the line crosses the strip exactly like the column boundary lines
cross the header strip (see docs/history/row-freezing.md).

documentation.zh: 返回行窗格分隔线向左延伸长度。
documentation.en: Return the left extension of row pane separators.

entries.comment:
Colour the row pane boundary is painted with when the separator style does not
name one. A subclass that can probe what the current style paints separators with
(the table does, through the header renderer) overrides this, so its row boundary
and its column boundary look identical; the default is the palette's mid colour.

documentation.zh: 返回行窗格分隔线颜色。
documentation.en: Return the row pane separator color.

entries.comment: Geometry of the row pane boundary lines, top to bottom (diagnostics/tests).

documentation.zh: 返回列或行窗格分隔线矩形集合。
documentation.en: Return the column or row pane separator rectangles.

entries.comment:
Container the scrolling rows are clipped into (null while no row is frozen,
in which case the row widgets keep the viewport as parent).

documentation.zh: 返回主滚动窗格的裁剪宿主，无需裁剪时可能为空。
documentation.en: Return the clipping host of the primary scrolling pane; may be null when clipping is unnecessary.

documentation.zh: 返回当前物化的 cell、项目或 section 数量。
documentation.en: Return the current materialized cell, item or section count.

documentation.zh: 返回当前保留的屏外项目数。
documentation.en: Return the current pinned offscreen item count.

documentation.zh: 返回当前物化的项目或 section 记录。

documentation.zh: 返回累计创建控件数。
documentation.en: Return the cumulative created widget count.

documentation.zh: 返回累计销毁控件数。
documentation.en: Return the cumulative destroyed widget count.

documentation.zh: 判断是否存在尚未执行的布局刷新。
documentation.en: Check whether a relayout is pending.

entries.comment:
Applies a pending invalidation synchronously (used by tests and by
code that needs a settled geometry before measuring).

documentation.en: Flush a pending relayout immediately when fresh geometry must be read synchronously.

documentation.zh: 项目单击或双击时发出，参数为命中的模型索引。

documentation.en: Emitted after visible ranges and materialized widgets update, for lightweight diagnostics or observation.

types.name: VirtualListView
types.comment:
Vertically stacked, virtualized list of QWidget items.

VirtualListView is the v0.1 entry point of VirtualItemViews: it materializes
only the visible, overscan and pinned items of a QAbstractItemModel and
recycles their widgets while scrolling. Row heights are managed by the
kernel (ItemHeightMode, estimates and measurement) and the list only adds the
row <-> QModelIndex mapping below rootIndex().

entries.comment: Item size modes live in the kernel so that the Table can reuse them.

documentation.zh: 构造 VirtualListView；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
documentation.en: Construct VirtualListView with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

documentation.zh: 销毁 VirtualListView 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
documentation.en: Destroy VirtualListView and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

entries.comment: Switching the model drops the root: it names an item of the previous model.

defaults.en: nullptr; no model is attached initially.

entries.comment:
Root of the list. An invalid index means the invisible root of the model.

The root is a *persistent* index, so it keeps naming the same item when
rows are inserted, removed or moved around it; an index of another model
(or a valid index while the view has no model) is rejected with a warning.

documentation.zh: 返回列表使用的布局策略对象。

types.name: VirtualTableView
types.comment:
Table MVP (architecture document §43 v0.4) on top of the virtualization
kernel.

Design invariants:
- HeaderGeometry is the single source of truth for column geometry and
state; the body, widget headers and the business row widgets all query
it (§14, §45.10),
- rows are virtualized exactly like VirtualListView: only visible rows,
overscan rows and pinned rows own a QWidget,
- every materialized row is one business QWidget (Row Widget Mode) whose
columns are positioned by ColumnHost or by the adapter hook, so no
cell-level QWidget is created (§45.8).

Cell Widget Mode provides 2D (row x column) virtualization through CellWidgetAdapter.

entries.comment:
Drag a column to a new position (the column header's reorder gesture). **Off by
default**: the drag changes the column order, so an application opts in.

The order it writes lives in HeaderGeometry, so the body follows either way; the
renderer that gets the gesture is the installed header *and* every pane clone (a
drag inside a frozen pane reorders like one in the scrolling pane). Column reordering
never needs a model.

entries.comment:
Drag a row number to a new position (the row-number strip's reorder gesture). **Off
by default**, and - unlike the column side - it needs a model that records the move:
a committed drag is reported through rowMoveRequested() and then applied with
`model()->moveRows()`, and the default `QAbstractItemModel::moveRows()` implementation
simply refuses it (the preview snaps back, the order stays).

**So a model of your own has to either derive from viv::ReorderableTableModel, which
records the order and implements moveRows(), or implement moveRows() itself** (and
read its data through the recorded order, see that class). Without one of the two,
turning this on changes nothing but the preview.

Turning it on while the view has **no** model instantiates a
`ReorderableTableModel` (owned by the view, 0 rows x 0 columns until the application
fills it) and installs it, so the gesture is usable without a model of your own.
Setting a model - before or after - always wins: no further model is instantiated
then, and the one that was installed stays alive as a child of the view.

itself, so this changes the order (and the body) at once. Pass

as well - the committed geometry is final right away, only the header slides to
it (§23). Renderers without their own section placement (a native QHeaderView)
ignore that and show the new order at once.

entries.comment:
Share of the leftover width this column takes: the columns with a factor > 0 split
"viewport width - the widths the other visible columns keep" in proportion to their
factors, so 1 : 2 : 1 makes the third column twice as wide as the first. A factor of
0 - the default - is a column that keeps its own width. Dragging any column edge
or calling setColumnWidth() clears all factors and disables last-
column stretching. Other columns keep their current widths until the application
sets positive factors again (see HeaderGeometry::setSectionStretchFactor()).

The columns fill the viewport, so a table whose columns all stretch has nothing to
scroll horizontally. The factors are part of the saved header state; the viewport
width a restored state is measured against is the one of the view restoring it.

Explicit pane list (§43 "advanced panes"): panes in visual order, each
with its own columns and scroll group. An empty list restores the default
"frozen left | scrollable | frozen right" layout, so setFrozenColumns()
stays the shorthand for the common case.

Any number of frozen panes and scrolling groups is supported. Panes of one
scroll group share a horizontal offset; the group of the *first* scrolling
pane is the primary group and is the one the header geometry and the
horizontal scroll bar drive, regardless of its group number. Every other
group is driven by setHorizontalOffset(group, offset).

entries.comment:
Colour the current style paints a header section separator with (probed by
rendering a section and reading its edge pixel). Both pane boundary lines - the
header edge and the body line - use it, so they match the separators between the
other columns instead of a guessed palette role.

This is pane composition, not a renderer's business (§17 of the vertical-header
decision): it used to live on the native QHeaderView adapter.

entries.comment:
Visual geometry animation of the installed header renderers: a section move
slides the section to its committed position instead of teleporting. Body
widgets follow visual positions according to columnFollowsHeaderVisual() and
rowFollowsHeaderVisual(), both enabled by default; geometry queries keep
reading the committed HeaderGeometry. Resizing, scrolling and pane changes
stay immediate. Renderers without their own section placement
(a native QHeaderView) ignore the setting. Default: enabled, 300 ms, OutCubic.

entries.comment:
Whether the body's column widgets follow the header's *visual* section
positions (§23/§24) - the dragged column and the columns making room for it
during a header drag, and the sliding column of a committed move - instead of
waiting for the commit and jumping there.

Only widget headers that can report a visual position take part
(VirtualHeaderView, see HeaderViewInterface::sectionVisualX()); the native
adapter paints its sections itself, so there the header and the body change
together at the commit whatever this is set to. The committed geometry stays
authoritative throughout: columnGeometry(), hit testing, spans, the scroll
bar and every query keep reading it, and only x is taken from the header -
the body never drives a header animation back into the geometry.

Default: enabled, which is what makes a header drag read as one movement.

documentation.zh: 设置内容列跟随表头可视顺序的开关。

documentation.zh: 返回内容列跟随表头可视顺序的开关。
documentation.en: Return the whether content columns follow visual header order.

entries.comment:
The row analogue of the setting above: while the row-number strip is dragged, the
body's rows follow the *visual* position of their section (the dragged row follows
the pointer, the rows making room slide along), instead of waiting for the commit.

Only the rows of the band being dragged follow; a frozen row pane keeps its rows
pinned (they are pinned at the edge by definition, and a drag never crosses a band).
The committed layout stays authoritative for everything else - `visualRect()`,
hit testing, the scroll bars and the model order never see an intermediate frame -
and only the framework-managed row widgets move. Default: enabled.

entries.signature: void setAdapter(WidgetAdapter *adapter, bool takeOwnership = false) override;
entries.comment:
Polymorphic override of the adapter entry point. The table needs both pointers to name
the same object: the recycler factory, `createItem()` and every row layout read the
*table* adapter, while the base kernel reads `m_adapter`. Letting them differ is not a
"does nothing" bug - adapter B then binds the QWidgets adapter A created, which is UB
as soon as their `WidgetType` namespaces disagree (P1 of the fourth review).

A plain `WidgetAdapter` is therefore rejected with a warning (the installed adapter
stays), and `nullptr` clears the adapter like the base setter does. `takeOwnership`
is only taken for an adapter the call accepts.

documentation.en: Set the item widget adapter.

notes.zh: takeOwnership 默认为 false，未转移所有权时调用方须保证 adapter 存活。RowWidgets 使用 TableWidgetAdapter，CellWidgets 使用 CellWidgetAdapter。创建控件和绑定数据应分离；复用时清除旧业务关联。
notes.en: takeOwnership defaults to false; the caller must keep a non-owned adapter alive. RowWidgets uses TableWidgetAdapter and CellWidgets uses CellWidgetAdapter. Separate widget creation from binding and clear obsolete business associations on reuse.

types.name: VirtualTreeView
types.comment:
Tree MVP (architecture document §43 v0.6).

The tree is a list kernel driven by a TreeVisibilityIndex:
- the model tree is flattened into *visible rows* (expanded nodes only),
- the layout axis (row heights, scrolling, recycling) is the same kernel as
the List and the Table,
- each materialized row is one business QWidget, inset by
`indentation * depth`; the branch indicator is drawn by the view and is
clickable, so the row widget stays untouched.

Model mutations (insert/remove/move/sort/filter/reset) rebuild the visible
row mapping while keeping the expansion state; expand/collapse are
incremental inside TreeVisibilityIndex. Row freezing is not supported.

remain item identities; SelectRows never selects a whole packed display row.

documentation.en: Return the minimum or maximum cell or item width.

entries.comment: Overrides follow persistent item identity across inserts, moves and sorting.

documentation.zh: 设置指定项目或批量项目的宽度覆盖，触发换行布局重算。
documentation.en: Set individual or bulk item width overrides and recalculate wrapping.

defaults.zh: 无逐项宽度覆盖；使用 adapter 估算宽度，非正值回退为 100，再应用宽度范围。
defaults.en: No per-item width overrides; uses adapter estimated widths, falling back to 100 for nonpositive values, then applies the width range.

entries.comment: Applies several explicit widths with one anchor capture and one invalidation.

documentation.zh: 设置指定项目或批量项目的宽度覆盖，触发换行布局重算。
documentation.en: Set individual or bulk item width overrides and recalculate wrapping.

defaults.zh: 无逐项宽度覆盖；使用 adapter 估算宽度，非正值回退为 100，再应用宽度范围。
defaults.en: No per-item width overrides; uses adapter estimated widths, falling back to 100 for nonpositive values, then applies the width range.

documentation.zh: 清除指定或全部项目宽度覆盖，恢复估值或测量提供的宽度。
documentation.en: Clear one or all item width overrides, restoring estimated or measured widths.

documentation.zh: 清除指定或全部项目宽度覆盖，恢复估值或测量提供的宽度。
documentation.en: Clear one or all item width overrides, restoring estimated or measured widths.

entries.comment: Refresh estimates after an external change, for example the adapter's font.

documentation.zh: 使指定布局或尺寸缓存失效；下次布局重新测量或计算。仅在内容尺寸确实变化时调用。
documentation.en: Invalidate the indicated layout or size cache for subsequent measurement or calculation. Use only when content dimensions actually change.

documentation.zh: 设置项目间距。
documentation.en: Set the spacing between items.

documentation.zh: 返回项目间距。
documentation.en: Return the spacing between items.

documentation.zh: 设置行间距。
documentation.en: Set the spacing between rows.

documentation.zh: 设置内容四周外边距。
documentation.en: Set the margins around the content.

documentation.zh: 返回内容四周外边距。
documentation.en: Return the margins around the content.

entries.comment: Logical leading/center/trailing; AlignAbsolute keeps physical sides in RTL.

documentation.zh: 设置行内项目对齐方式。
documentation.en: Set the item alignment within a line.

documentation.zh: 返回行内项目对齐方式。
documentation.en: Return the item alignment within a line.

documentation.zh: 返回布局实际排出的显示行数。
documentation.en: Return the number of display rows produced by the layout.

documentation.zh: 返回项目在流式排版中的显示行号或列号，与原始模型行号不同。
documentation.en: Return the item's display row or column in the flow layout, distinct from its original model row.

entries.comment: State shapes cover individual item bounds, never trailing blank space.

documentation.zh: 设置hover 或选中背景绘制开关。
documentation.en: Set the hover or selection background painting setting.

defaults.zh: true；内置 hover / selection 背景启用。
defaults.en: true; built-in hover / selection backgrounds are enabled.

documentation.zh: 返回hover 或选中背景绘制开关。
documentation.en: Return the hover or selection background painting setting.

defaults.zh: true；内置 hover / selection 背景启用。
defaults.en: true; built-in hover / selection backgrounds are enabled.

documentation.zh: 设置状态背景圆角半径。
documentation.en: Set the state background corner radius.

documentation.zh: 返回状态背景圆角半径。
documentation.en: Return the state background corner radius.

entries.comment: Emitted after a pass commits changed item geometry.

documentation.zh: 对应布局重新计算后发出，通知业务更新依赖排版的内容。
documentation.en: Emitted when the corresponding layout changes so clients can update layout-dependent content.

types.name: WidgetAdapter
types.comment:
Bridge between the virtualization kernel and the business widgets.

The adapter never paints: it owns the QWidget lifecycle of an item. It must
be able to bind the same widget to a different QModelIndex many times, and
unbindWidget() must stop every activity that is tied to the old index
(QTimer, animation, QMovie, async image requests, business subscriptions).

documentation.zh: 销毁 WidgetAdapter 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
documentation.en: Destroy WidgetAdapter and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

entries.comment: Classifies an index into a recycler pool. The default keeps a single pool.

documentation.zh: 返回复用类型标识。只有结构兼容的控件才应使用同一个类型值。
documentation.en: Return the recycling type identifier. Only structurally compatible widgets should share a type.

entries.comment: Creates a new widget for \a type; \a parent is the view viewport.

documentation.zh: 在给定 parent 下创建指定类型的控件。只构造界面；每次项目数据由 bind 回调填充。
documentation.en: Create a widget of the requested type under parent. Construct the UI here; populate item data in bind callbacks.

entries.signature: virtual void bindWidget(WidgetType type, QWidget *widget, const QModelIndex &index);
entries.comment:
Fills \a widget with the data of \a index. Called before the widget is
shown, so implementations must not rely on being visible yet. The type
is the recycler type used to create this widget, not a new classification.

Kept as the compatibility entry point. New adapters can override the
ItemBindingContext overload below and receive the complete row/node
payload directly.

documentation.zh: 将当前模型索引或绑定上下文的数据写入复用控件。每次绑定应覆盖旧内容，避免残留；不要重复连接同一信号。
documentation.en: Populate a reusable widget from the current index or binding context. Replace stale content on every bind and avoid duplicate signal connections.

entries.signature: virtual void bindWidget(WidgetType type, QWidget *widget, const ItemBindingContext &context);
entries.comment:
Fills \a widget with the current row/node payload and binding metadata.
The default delegates to the index-only callback for existing adapters.

documentation.zh: 将当前模型索引或绑定上下文的数据写入复用控件。每次绑定应覆盖旧内容，避免残留；不要重复连接同一信号。
documentation.en: Populate a reusable widget from the current index or binding context. Replace stale content on every bind and avoid duplicate signal connections.

entries.signature: virtual void visualStateChanged(WidgetType type, QWidget *widget, const QModelIndex &index);
entries.comment:
Called after binding and when hover or selection changes. The widget can
query the view's visualState() and paint its own background.

documentation.zh: 接收框架计算后的 hover、选中和动画进度；据此更新按钮等子控件，通常无需重复绘制框架状态背景。
documentation.en: Receive framework-computed hover, selection and animation progress. Update child controls from this state; ordinarily do not duplicate framework background painting.

entries.signature: virtual void visualStateChanged(WidgetType type, QWidget *widget, const ItemBindingContext &context);
entries.comment:
Context-aware visual-state callback. Existing adapters continue to receive
the index-only callback through the default implementation.

documentation.zh: 接收框架计算后的 hover、选中和动画进度；据此更新按钮等子控件，通常无需重复绘制框架状态背景。
documentation.en: Receive framework-computed hover, selection and animation progress. Update child controls from this state; ordinarily do not duplicate framework background painting.

entries.signature: virtual void unbindWidget(WidgetType type, QWidget *widget, const QModelIndex &index);
entries.comment:
Detaches \a widget from \a index. Called before the widget is hidden and
recycled, and before a widget is rebound to another index.

documentation.zh: 解除控件与旧项目的业务关联，取消旧请求并清理临时状态，供下次复用。
documentation.en: Detach the widget from its old item, cancel obsolete work and clear transient state before reuse.

entries.signature: virtual void unbindWidget(WidgetType type, QWidget *widget, const ItemBindingContext &context);
entries.comment:
Context-aware lifecycle callback. Existing adapters continue to receive
the index-only callback through the default implementation.

documentation.zh: 解除控件与旧项目的业务关联，取消旧请求并清理临时状态，供下次复用。
documentation.en: Detach the widget from its old item, cancel obsolete work and clear transient state before reuse.

entries.signature: virtual QSize estimatedSize(WidgetType type, const QModelIndex &index) const = 0;
entries.comment:
Estimated size of an index before it is materialized. Used for newly
inserted rows in variable-height layouts, and for natural item widths in
VirtualWrapView. The type is widgetType(index).

documentation.zh: 返回布局估计尺寸，用于控件物化前或测量前的布局。保持回调轻量。
documentation.en: Return an estimated layout size used before materialization or measurement. Keep this callback inexpensive.

types.name: WidgetRecycler
types.comment:
Pool of QWidget instances grouped by WidgetType.

The recycler is the only place where item widgets are created or destroyed.
Scrolling must therefore only bind/recycle widgets: steady-state scrolling
performs no allocation at all.

entries.comment: Creates a widget of \a type parented to \a parent.
Default upper bound of one pool, used by trim().

documentation.zh: 构造 WidgetRecycler；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
documentation.en: Construct WidgetRecycler with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

documentation.zh: 销毁 WidgetRecycler 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
documentation.en: Destroy WidgetRecycler and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

documentation.zh: 此复制或赋值操作被禁用；该对象不能按值复制。
documentation.en: This copy or assignment operation is deleted; the object cannot be copied by value.

documentation.zh: 此复制或赋值操作被禁用；该对象不能按值复制。
documentation.en: This copy or assignment operation is deleted; the object cannot be copied by value.

documentation.zh: 设置回收控件父控件。
documentation.en: Set the recycled widget parent.

defaults.zh: 构造 parent 为 QWidget 时使用该对象，否则 nullptr。
defaults.en: Uses the constructor parent if it is a QWidget, otherwise nullptr.

documentation.zh: 返回回收控件父控件。
documentation.en: Return the recycled widget parent.

defaults.zh: 构造 parent 为 QWidget 时使用该对象，否则 nullptr。
defaults.en: Uses the constructor parent if it is a QWidget, otherwise nullptr.

documentation.zh: 设置按 WidgetType 创建控件的工厂。
documentation.en: Set the widget factory indexed by WidgetType.

defaults.zh: 空工厂；独立 recycler 不会创建控件，视图会安装自己的工厂。
defaults.en: Empty factory; a standalone recycler cannot create widgets, while views install their own factories.

entries.comment:
Returns a widget of \a type: a pooled one when available, otherwise a
newly created one. Returns nullptr when the factory fails.
The returned widget is hidden; the caller binds it and shows it.

documentation.zh: 按 widgetType 从池中取出可复用控件；池空时通过工厂创建。
documentation.en: Acquire a widget by type, reusing a pooled instance or creating one through the factory.

entries.comment:
Returns \a widget to the pool of \a type. The widget is hidden; when the
pool is full the widget is scheduled for deletion (deleteLater()).

documentation.zh: 将控件退回按类型分类的复用池。回收前由适配器解绑业务状态。
documentation.en: Return a widget to its type-specific pool after adapter state has been unbound.

entries.comment: Retires an acquired widget without making it available for reuse.

documentation.zh: 将控件从回收器管理中移除并安排销毁。
documentation.en: Remove a widget from recycler management and schedule its destruction.

entries.comment: Upper bound of the pool of \a type. A negative size means unlimited.

documentation.zh: 设置回收池容量上限。
documentation.en: Set the recycler pool capacity limit.

notes.zh: 按 WidgetType 分别限制池容量；负数表示不限制。池满时回收控件会安排延迟删除。
notes.en: Limits apply per WidgetType; negative means unlimited. Recycling into a full pool schedules deferred deletion.

documentation.zh: 返回回收池容量上限。
documentation.en: Return the recycler pool capacity limit.

notes.zh: 按 WidgetType 分别限制池容量；负数表示不限制。池满时回收控件会安排延迟删除。
notes.en: Limits apply per WidgetType; negative means unlimited. Recycling into a full pool schedules deferred deletion.

documentation.zh: 返回当前池内空闲控件数；带类型参数的重载只统计该类型。
documentation.en: Return the current pooled idle widget count; typed overloads count only that type.

documentation.zh: 返回当前池内空闲控件数；带类型参数的重载只统计该类型。
documentation.en: Return the current pooled idle widget count; typed overloads count only that type.

documentation.zh: 返回当前已借出控件数。
documentation.en: Return the current acquired widget count.

entries.comment: Widgets created by the factory since construction.

documentation.zh: 返回累计创建控件数。
documentation.en: Return the cumulative created widget count.

entries.comment: Widgets actually destroyed (destruction confirmed by QObject::destroyed).

documentation.zh: 返回累计销毁控件数。
documentation.en: Return the cumulative destroyed widget count.

entries.comment: Widgets whose destruction was scheduled through deleteLater().

documentation.zh: 返回等待延迟销毁控件数。
documentation.en: Return the widgets pending deferred destruction.

documentation.zh: 返回累计获取控件次数。
documentation.en: Return the cumulative widget acquisition count.

entries.comment: Acquires that were served from a pool instead of creating a widget.

documentation.zh: 返回累计复用已有控件次数。
documentation.en: Return the cumulative widget reuse count.

entries.comment: Widgets that exist right now (materialized + pooled).

documentation.zh: 返回当前尚存活控件总数。
documentation.en: Return the current live widget count.

documentation.zh: 判断控件是否当前位于空闲回收池。
documentation.en: Check whether a widget is currently in an idle recycler pool.

entries.comment: Deletes pooled widgets above the configured per-type limit.

documentation.zh: 将空闲池缩减至容量限制，释放多余控件。
documentation.en: Trim idle pools to their capacity limits, releasing excess widgets.

entries.comment: Deletes every pooled widget immediately.

documentation.zh: 立即删除回收池中的全部空闲控件；活动控件不属于池内清理范围。
documentation.en: Immediately delete all idle pooled widgets; active widgets are outside this pool cleanup.

types.name: WrapLayout
types.comment:
Small collections of real widgets, packed in order at a uniform height.
Widths use each item's size hint and minimum/maximum constraints. Hidden
widgets do not occupy space (unless retainSizeWhenHidden is enabled).
This layout supplies heightForWidth; use WrapWidget for bounded scrolling.

documentation.zh: 构造 WrapLayout；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
documentation.en: Construct WrapLayout with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

documentation.zh: 销毁 WrapLayout 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
documentation.en: Destroy WrapLayout and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

documentation.zh: 将布局项加入换行布局，由布局管理其几何位置。
documentation.en: Add a layout item to the wrapping layout, which manages its geometry.

entries.comment: Inserts a widget; the parent widget takes QObject ownership.

documentation.zh: 把控件加入指定位置；WrapLayout/WrapWidget 使用真实控件，不进行虚拟化回收。
documentation.en: Add a widget at the requested position. WrapLayout/WrapWidget manage real widgets without virtualized recycling.

documentation.zh: 返回布局、索引或范围中的项目数量。
documentation.en: Return the item count in the layout, index or range.

documentation.zh: 返回指定位置的布局项；不存在时返回空。
documentation.en: Return the layout item at the given position, or null when absent.

entries.comment: Removes a layout item without deleting it or its widget.

documentation.zh: 移除并返回指定位置的布局项，调用方负责布局项后续生命周期。
documentation.en: Remove and return the layout item at the given position; the caller manages its subsequent lifetime.

documentation.zh: 返回布局或控件的建议尺寸或最小建议尺寸，供父布局协商；auto height 启用时由内容固定高度。
documentation.en: Return preferred or minimum size hints for parent layout negotiation; auto height fixes the actual height from content when enabled.

documentation.zh: 返回布局或控件的建议尺寸或最小建议尺寸，供父布局协商；auto height 启用时由内容固定高度。
documentation.en: Return preferred or minimum size hints for parent layout negotiation; auto height fixes the actual height from content when enabled.

documentation.zh: 返回布局可以扩展的方向，供 Qt 布局系统协商空间。
documentation.en: Return the directions in which the layout can expand for Qt layout negotiation.

documentation.zh: 说明布局是否根据宽度计算高度，供 Qt 调用 heightForWidth。
documentation.en: Report whether height depends on width so Qt can use heightForWidth.

documentation.zh: 按给定宽度计算换行后的所需高度，包含布局自身间距和边距。
documentation.en: Compute the required wrapped height for a width, including the layout's spacing and margins.

documentation.zh: 设置布局几何对象或矩形。
documentation.en: Set the layout geometry object or rectangle.

defaults.zh: 没有固定默认矩形；由父布局分配的可用矩形决定。
defaults.en: No fixed default rectangle; determined by the available geometry assigned by the parent layout.

documentation.zh: 使指定布局或尺寸缓存失效；下次布局重新测量或计算。仅在内容尺寸确实变化时调用。
documentation.en: Invalidate the indicated layout or size cache for subsequent measurement or calculation. Use only when content dimensions actually change.

documentation.zh: 设置项目统一固定高度。
documentation.en: Set the uniform fixed item height.

examples.zh: 少量真实标签控件按行换行并限制容器高度。chips 为已加入父布局的 WrapWidget，需包含 WrapLayout 和 QLabel；addWidget() 接管标签所有权。内边距由 WrapLayout 设置，总高度上限包含容器装饰。
examples.en: Wrap a small set of real label widgets and cap container height. chips is a WrapWidget already placed in its parent layout; include WrapLayout and QLabel. addWidget() takes label ownership. WrapLayout sets inner margins; the total height limit includes container decorations.

documentation.zh: 返回项目统一固定高度。
documentation.en: Return the uniform fixed item height.

documentation.zh: 设置项目间距。
documentation.en: Set the spacing between items.

examples.zh: 少量真实标签控件按行换行并限制容器高度。chips 为已加入父布局的 WrapWidget，需包含 WrapLayout 和 QLabel；addWidget() 接管标签所有权。内边距由 WrapLayout 设置，总高度上限包含容器装饰。
examples.en: Wrap a small set of real label widgets and cap container height. chips is a WrapWidget already placed in its parent layout; include WrapLayout and QLabel. addWidget() takes label ownership. WrapLayout sets inner margins; the total height limit includes container decorations.

documentation.zh: 返回项目间距。
documentation.en: Return the spacing between items.

documentation.zh: 设置行间距。
documentation.en: Set the spacing between rows.

examples.zh: 少量真实标签控件按行换行并限制容器高度。chips 为已加入父布局的 WrapWidget，需包含 WrapLayout 和 QLabel；addWidget() 接管标签所有权。内边距由 WrapLayout 设置，总高度上限包含容器装饰。
examples.en: Wrap a small set of real label widgets and cap container height. chips is a WrapWidget already placed in its parent layout; include WrapLayout and QLabel. addWidget() takes label ownership. WrapLayout sets inner margins; the total height limit includes container decorations.

documentation.zh: 返回行间距。
documentation.en: Return the spacing between rows.

entries.comment: Logical leading/center/trailing alignment; AlignAbsolute keeps physical sides.

documentation.zh: 设置行内项目对齐方式。
documentation.en: Set the item alignment within a line.

documentation.zh: 返回行内项目对齐方式。
documentation.en: Return the item alignment within a line.

entries.comment: Invalidated by child visibility, size hints or layout configuration.

documentation.zh: 对应布局重新计算后发出，通知业务更新依赖排版的内容。
documentation.en: Emitted when the corresponding layout changes so clients can update layout-dependent content.

types.name: WrapWidget
types.comment:
A scrolling host for a small collection of real widgets. Auto height is on
by default and fixes the host height to its wrapped content, independently
of the parent layout's available height. An optional auto-height maximum
bounds the host and lets excess content scroll internally.
The content widget and layout belong to this host and must not be replaced.

documentation.zh: 构造 WrapWidget；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
documentation.en: Construct WrapWidget with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

documentation.zh: 销毁 WrapWidget 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
documentation.en: Destroy WrapWidget and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

documentation.zh: 返回真实控件换行布局对象。
documentation.en: Return the wrapping layout for real widgets.

examples.zh: 少量真实标签控件按行换行并限制容器高度。chips 为已加入父布局的 WrapWidget，需包含 WrapLayout 和 QLabel；addWidget() 接管标签所有权。内边距由 WrapLayout 设置，总高度上限包含容器装饰。
examples.en: Wrap a small set of real label widgets and cap container height. chips is a WrapWidget already placed in its parent layout; include WrapLayout and QLabel. addWidget() takes label ownership. WrapLayout sets inner margins; the total height limit includes container decorations.

entries.comment: Transfers widget ownership to the content host.

documentation.zh: 把控件加入指定位置；WrapLayout/WrapWidget 使用真实控件，不进行虚拟化回收。
documentation.en: Add a widget at the requested position. WrapLayout/WrapWidget manage real widgets without virtualized recycling.

notes.zh: 控件所有权转移给内部内容宿主。takeWidget 会隐藏并解除父子关系，把所有权交还调用方；clear 会直接删除全部子控件。
notes.en: Widget ownership transfers to the internal content host. takeWidget hides and detaches a widget, returning ownership to the caller; clear deletes all contained widgets.

documentation.zh: 把控件加入指定位置；WrapLayout/WrapWidget 使用真实控件，不进行虚拟化回收。
documentation.en: Add a widget at the requested position. WrapLayout/WrapWidget manage real widgets without virtualized recycling.

notes.zh: 控件所有权转移给内部内容宿主。takeWidget 会隐藏并解除父子关系，把所有权交还调用方；clear 会直接删除全部子控件。
notes.en: Widget ownership transfers to the internal content host. takeWidget hides and detaches a widget, returning ownership to the caller; clear deletes all contained widgets.

entries.comment: Removes, hides and detaches the widget; the caller takes ownership.

documentation.zh: 移出指定控件并返回它，调用方负责后续处理。
documentation.en: Remove and return the specified widget for the caller to manage.

entries.comment: Deletes all contained widgets and layout items.

documentation.zh: 删除 WrapWidget 中全部控件及布局项。
documentation.en: Delete every widget and layout item contained in WrapWidget.

entries.comment:
Fixes the host to its content height; disabling restores the previous
QWidget height constraints and vertical size policy.

documentation.zh: 设置按内容固定视图高度的开关。
documentation.en: Set the content-based fixed view height setting.

notes.zh: 虚拟视图默认关闭，WrapWidget 默认开启。启用后按内容设置固定高度，父布局不再把它压缩；上限为 0 时不限高。高度包含边距、间距、表头和实际边框等占位。使用 setAutoHeightMaximumHeight 控制上限，不要同时用 QWidget 高度约束干预；关闭后恢复原约束。内部无滚动范围时，滚轮交给外层。
notes.en: Disabled by default on virtual views and enabled on WrapWidget. When enabled, content sets a fixed height that the parent layout cannot compress; a maximum of 0 is unlimited. The height includes margins, gaps, headers and occupied frame space. Use setAutoHeightMaximumHeight rather than competing QWidget height constraints; disabling restores prior constraints. Wheel input propagates outward when there is no internal scroll range.

examples.zh: 少量真实标签控件按行换行并限制容器高度。chips 为已加入父布局的 WrapWidget，需包含 WrapLayout 和 QLabel；addWidget() 接管标签所有权。内边距由 WrapLayout 设置，总高度上限包含容器装饰。
examples.en: Wrap a small set of real label widgets and cap container height. chips is a WrapWidget already placed in its parent layout; include WrapLayout and QLabel. addWidget() takes label ownership. WrapLayout sets inner margins; the total height limit includes container decorations.

documentation.zh: 返回按内容固定视图高度的开关。
documentation.en: Return the content-based fixed view height setting.

notes.zh: 虚拟视图默认关闭，WrapWidget 默认开启。启用后按内容设置固定高度，父布局不再把它压缩；上限为 0 时不限高。高度包含边距、间距、表头和实际边框等占位。使用 setAutoHeightMaximumHeight 控制上限，不要同时用 QWidget 高度约束干预；关闭后恢复原约束。内部无滚动范围时，滚轮交给外层。

entries.comment:
Limits the total auto height, including decorations. Zero (the default)
removes the limit; negative values are treated as zero. Use this instead
of QWidget height setters while auto height owns the host height.
